title: AMLRIS: Alignment-aware Masked Learning for Referring Image Segmentation
summary:
Referring Image Segmentation (RIS) aims to segment the object in an image uniquely referred to by a natural language expression. However, RIS training often contains hard-to-align and instance-specific visual signals; optimizing on such pixels injects misleading gradients and drives the model in the wrong direction. By explicitly estimating pixel-level vision-language alignment, the learner can suppress low-alignment regions, concentrate on reliable cues, and acquire more generalizable alignment features.
  In this paper, we propose Alignment-Aware Masked Learning (AML), a simple yet effective training strategy that quantifies region-referent alignment (PMME) and filters out unreliable pixels during optimization (AFM). Specifically, each sample first computes a similarity map between visual and textual features, and then masks out pixels falling below an adaptive similarity threshold, thereby excluding poorly aligned regions from the training process. AML does not require architectural changes and incurs no inference overhead, directing attention to the areas aligned with the textual description. Experiments on the RefCOCO (vanilla/+/g) datasets show that AML achieves state-of-the-art results across all 8 splits, and beyond improving RIS performance, AML also enhances the model's robustness to diverse descriptions and scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/pipashu1/AMLRIS.

AI.title_translation: AMLRIS：面向指代图像分割的对齐感知掩码学习
AI.tldr: 提出一种无需改模型结构、无推理开销的对齐感知掩码学习（AML），通过估计像素级视觉-语言对齐并在训练时屏蔽低对齐像素，减少误导梯度，在RefCOCO系列数据集8个划分上取得SOTA并提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: RIS训练中存在难对齐且实例特定的视觉信号；在这些像素上优化会注入误导梯度、使模型学习方向偏离。需要一种能抑制低对齐区域、聚焦可靠线索并学习更可泛化对齐特征的训练方式。
AI.method: 提出Alignment-Aware Masked Learning（AML）训练策略：1) 量化区域-指代表达对齐（PMME）；2) 在优化时过滤不可靠像素（AFM）。具体做法是为每个样本计算视觉与文本特征的相似度图，并用自适应相似度阈值掩码掉低于阈值的像素，从而在训练中排除对齐差的区域。方法不改网络结构、无额外推理开销。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO（vanilla/+/g）数据集的全部8个划分上达到最先进（SOTA）性能；除提升RIS精度外，还增强了模型对多样化描述与场景的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 显式估计像素级视觉-语言对齐并在训练中屏蔽低对齐像素，可减少误导梯度、让模型聚焦可靠对齐线索，从而在不增加推理成本的情况下显著提升RIS性能与泛化鲁棒性。
AI.translation:
指代图像分割（RIS）旨在根据自然语言表达分割图像中被唯一指代的目标。然而，RIS训练常包含难以对齐且与具体实例强相关的视觉信号；在这些像素上优化会引入误导梯度并把模型带偏。若能显式估计像素级视觉-语言对齐，学习器便可抑制低对齐区域、专注可靠线索，并获得更具泛化性的对齐特征。
本文提出对齐感知掩码学习（AML），一种简洁而有效的训练策略：量化区域-指代表达对齐（PMME），并在优化时过滤不可靠像素（AFM）。具体而言，每个样本先计算视觉与文本特征的相似度图，再以自适应相似度阈值掩掉低于阈值的像素，从训练过程中排除对齐较差的区域。AML无需改动网络结构，也不带来推理开销，使模型更关注与文本描述对齐的区域。在RefCOCO（vanilla/+/g）数据集实验中，AML在全部8个划分上取得SOTA；除提升RIS性能外，也增强了模型对多样描述与场景的鲁棒性。代码：https://github.com/pipashu1/AMLRIS。
AI.summary: 论文针对RIS训练中“像素级视觉信号与文本指代难对齐”导致的误导梯度问题，提出AML训练策略：先计算视觉-文本相似度图来估计像素/区域对齐程度（PMME），再用自适应阈值在训练时掩蔽低对齐像素（AFM），从而让优化集中在可靠对齐区域。该方法无需结构改动且不增加推理成本，在RefCOCO系列8个划分上达成SOTA，并提升对不同描述与场景的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 指代图像分割(RIS); 视觉-语言对齐; 像素级相似度图; 掩码学习; 自适应阈值; 鲁棒性; RefCOCO
AI.comments: 优点：方法简单、可作为训练策略直接插件式使用；不改结构且无推理开销；通过抑制低对齐像素减少噪声梯度，实验显示性能与鲁棒性提升。局限/未说明：PMME与AFM的具体定义与实现细节、阈值自适应策略的公式、对其他数据集/任务的泛化与消融结果在摘要中未提及。

title: Active Value Querying to Minimize Additive Error in Subadditive Set Function Learning
summary: Subadditive set functions play a pivotal role in computational economics (especially in combinatorial auctions), combinatorial optimization or artificial intelligence applications such as interpretable machine learning. However, specifying a set function requires assigning values to an exponentially large number of subsets in general, a task that is often resource-intensive in practice, particularly when the values derive from external sources such as retraining of machine learning models. A~simple omission of certain values introduces ambiguity that becomes even more significant when the incomplete set function has to be further optimized over. Motivated by the well-known result about inapproximability of subadditive functions using deterministic value queries with respect to a multiplicative error, we study a problem of approximating an unknown subadditive (or a subclass of thereof) set function with respect to an additive error -- i. e., we aim to efficiently close the distance between minimal and maximal completions. Our contributions are threefold: (i) a thorough exploration of minimal and maximal completions of different classes of set functions with missing values and an analysis of their resulting distance; (ii) the development of methods to minimize this distance over classes of set functions with a known prior, achieved by disclosing values of additional subsets in both offline and online manner; and (iii) empirical demonstrations of the algorithms' performance in practical scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 主动价值查询：最小化次可加集合函数学习中的加性误差
AI.tldr: 研究在缺失部分子集取值时，如何通过主动查询额外子集的价值，在已知先验类别（次可加及其子类）下最小化“最小补全”和“最大补全”之间的加性误差，并给出离线/在线算法与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 次可加集合函数在组合拍卖、组合优化与可解释机器学习等场景重要，但完整指定需要对指数多子集赋值，代价高；缺失值会导致补全歧义并影响后续优化。鉴于用确定性价值查询在乘性误差下存在不可近似性，作者转而研究加性误差下的近似，并希望通过主动披露/查询少量额外子集价值来缩小不确定性。
AI.method: 1) 系统研究不同集合函数类别在存在缺失值时的最小补全与最大补全，并分析二者距离；2) 在给定函数类别先验的前提下，提出通过主动披露/查询额外子集取值来最小化该距离的方法，包含离线与在线两种查询策略；3) 通过实验在实际场景中评估算法表现。
AI.result: 提出了用于最小化最小/最大补全距离的离线与在线主动查询算法，并通过实证实验展示这些算法在实践场景中的性能。具体定量结果未在摘要中给出。
AI.conclusion: 通过研究补全边界并进行主动价值查询，可以在次可加（及其子类）集合函数学习中有效降低由缺失取值带来的加性不确定性/误差，并且方法在实验中表现良好。更具体结论未在摘要中展开。
AI.translation: 次可加集合函数在计算经济学（尤其是组合拍卖）、组合优化以及诸如可解释机器学习等人工智能应用中起着关键作用。然而，一般而言，要指定一个集合函数需要为指数数量的子集赋值，这在实践中往往代价高昂，尤其当这些取值来自外部来源（例如需要重新训练机器学习模型）时更是如此。简单地省略某些取值会引入歧义，而当不完整的集合函数还需进一步被优化时，这种歧义会更加显著。受关于使用确定性价值查询在乘性误差意义下无法近似次可加函数这一著名结果的启发，我们研究以加性误差来近似未知次可加（或其某些子类）集合函数的问题——即希望高效缩小最小补全与最大补全之间的距离。我们的贡献主要有三点：(i) 深入探讨在缺失取值时不同类别集合函数的最小补全与最大补全，并分析它们产生的距离；(ii) 在已知类别先验的情况下，提出通过在离线与在线两种方式下披露额外子集取值来最小化该距离的方法；(iii) 通过实证展示算法在实际场景中的表现。
AI.summary: 本文将“缺失子集取值”的次可加集合函数学习视为一个补全区间（最小补全到最大补全）收缩问题，目标是以加性误差度量来缩小该区间。作者首先分析不同函数类别在缺失值条件下的最小/最大补全及其距离来源，然后设计离线与在线的主动价值查询策略，选择性查询额外子集的价值以最小化该距离，并用实验验证算法在实际任务中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 次可加集合函数, 集合函数学习, 主动查询, 价值查询, 加性误差, 最小补全, 最大补全, 缺失数据补全, 组合拍卖, 组合优化, 在线算法, 离线算法, 不可近似性
AI.comments: 摘要强调从乘性不可近似性转向加性误差目标，并以“最小/最大补全距离”作为不确定性的核心度量；贡献结构清晰（理论分析+算法+实验），但摘要未提供算法复杂度、查询次数界或实验的具体指标与对比基线。

title: A Minimal Agent for Automated Theorem Proving
summary: We propose a minimal agentic baseline that enables systematic comparison across different AI-based theorem prover architectures. This design implements the core features shared among state-of-the-art systems: iterative proof refinement, library search and context management. We evaluate this agentic approach using qualitatively different benchmarks and compare various frontier language models and design choices. Our results show competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art approaches, while using a significantly simpler architecture. Additionally, we demonstrate consistent advantages of an iterative approach over multiple single-shot generations, especially in terms of sample efficiency and cost effectiveness. The implementation is released open-source as a candidate reference for future research and as an accessible prover for the community.

AI.title_translation: 用于自动定理证明的最小化智能体
AI.tldr: 提出一个涵盖迭代式证明改进、库搜索与上下文管理的“最小智能体”基线，在多类基准上以更简单架构取得与SOTA相近的表现，并证明迭代生成在样本效率与成本上优于单次生成。
AI.motivation: 现有AI定理证明系统架构复杂、实现各异，难以进行系统化、可比的横向评测；因此需要一个包含主流系统共同核心能力、但尽可能简洁的参考基线，以便公平比较不同架构与设计选择。
AI.method: 设计并实现一个最小化智能体基线，包含三项核心机制：迭代式证明精炼（iterative proof refinement）、证明库/定理库搜索（library search）、上下文管理（context management）；在“质性不同”的多个基准上评估该智能体，并比较不同前沿语言模型与若干设计选择；同时将实现开源发布。
AI.result: 在所评测的不同基准上，该最小智能体在显著更简单的架构下表现具有竞争力，可与当前最先进方法相比；此外，迭代式方法相较多次单次（single-shot）生成展现出一致优势，尤其体现在样本效率与成本效果方面。
AI.conclusion: 最小化智能体基线能够作为可复现、可对比的参考实现，在保持架构简洁的同时达到接近SOTA的性能；迭代式生成策略在自动定理证明中更具样本效率与成本优势；开源实现可作为未来研究的参考与社区可用的证明器。
AI.translation: 我们提出一个最小化的智能体式基线，使不同AI定理证明器架构之间能够进行系统化比较。该设计实现了当前最先进系统所共有的核心特性：迭代式证明精炼、库搜索与上下文管理。我们使用质性不同的基准对这一智能体方法进行评估，并比较多种前沿语言模型与设计选择。结果表明，在显著更简单的架构下，我们的方法仍能与最先进方法相比表现出有竞争力的性能。此外，我们展示了迭代式方法相较于多次单次生成在多个方面具有一致优势，尤其是在样本效率与成本效果上。实现已开源发布，作为未来研究的候选参考，并为社区提供一个易用的证明器。
AI.summary: 论文提出一个面向自动定理证明的“最小智能体”基线，抽取并实现SOTA系统的共同核心模块（迭代精炼、库搜索、上下文管理），并在多类基准上对不同前沿大模型与设计选择进行对比评测。实验显示该简化架构仍具SOTA级竞争力，同时迭代式生成在样本效率与成本方面稳定优于单次生成；代码开源以作为后续研究与社区使用的参考实现。
AI.keywords: 自动定理证明；智能体；最小化基线；迭代式证明精炼；库搜索；上下文管理；语言模型；样本效率；成本效果；开源实现
AI.comments: 基于摘要可见其主要贡献在于提供可对比的简化基线并强调迭代策略的效率优势；但摘要未给出具体基准名称、定量指标、统计显著性或失败案例与适用边界，因此性能提升幅度与泛化范围仍需结合全文确认。

title: How Large Language Models Get Stuck: Early structure with persistent errors
summary: Linguistic insights may help make Large Language Model (LLM) training more efficient. We trained Meta's OPT model on the 100M word BabyLM dataset, and evaluated it on the BLiMP benchmark, which consists of 67 classes, each defined by sentence pairs that differ in a targeted syntactic or semantic rule violation. We tested the model's preference for grammatical over ungrammatical sentences across training iterations and grammatical types. In nearly one-third of the BLiMP classes, OPT fails to consistently assign a higher likelihood to grammatical sentences, even after extensive training. When it fails, it often establishes a clear (erroneous) separation of the likelihoods at an early stage of processing and sustains this to the end of our training phase. We hypothesize that this mis-categorization is costly because it creates entrenched biases that must, eventually, be reversed in order for the model to perform well. We probe this phenomenon using a mixture of qualitative (based on linguistic theory and the theory of Deep Learning) and quantitative (based on numerical testing) assessments. Our qualitative assessments indicate that only some BLiMP tests are meaningful guides. We conclude by articulating a hypothesis, the Bigram Hypothesis, which claims that the learning process will exhibit erroneous entrenchment if bigram statistics bias the model toward wrong distinctions early in training, and we describe a method of testing the hypothesis on appropriately selected BLiMP classes.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型如何陷入停滞：早期结构与持续性错误
AI.tldr: 作者发现OPT在BLiMP约三分之一语法类别上会在训练早期形成错误偏好并长期固化，并提出“大二元组假设”解释这种错误“固着”。
AI.motivation: 利用语言学洞见提升LLM训练效率，并理解模型在语法/语义规则学习中为何会出现长期难以纠正的系统性错误。
AI.method: 在1亿词BabyLM数据集上训练Meta的OPT模型；使用含67类最小对立句对的BLiMP基准评测；跨训练迭代与语法类型跟踪模型对“语法句”相对“非语法句”的似然偏好；结合定性分析（语言学理论与深度学习理论视角）与定量分析（数值测试）进行探查，并提出在合适BLiMP类别上检验假设的方法。
AI.result: 在接近三分之一的BLiMP类别中，OPT即使经过大量训练也无法稳定地给语法句更高似然；出现失败时，模型常在训练早期就建立起清晰但错误的似然分离，并将该错误分离持续到训练结束；定性评估还表明并非所有BLiMP测试都能作为有意义的指导指标。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出“大二元组假设”（Bigram Hypothesis）：若训练早期的二元组统计会将模型偏置到错误区分上，则学习过程将出现错误固着；并给出在恰当选择的BLiMP类别上测试该假设的方法。
AI.translation: 语言学洞见可能有助于提高大型语言模型（LLM）训练效率。我们在1亿词的BabyLM数据集上训练了Meta的OPT模型，并在BLiMP基准上进行评估。BLiMP由67个类别组成，每个类别由成对句子定义，这些句子仅在某个目标句法或语义规则的违背上不同。我们在不同训练迭代与不同语法类型上，测试模型是否更偏好语法句而非非语法句。在接近三分之一的BLiMP类别中，OPT即便经过大量训练也未能持续稳定地给语法句分配更高似然。当模型失败时，它往往在处理的早期阶段就建立起清晰（但错误）的似然分离，并将其一直维持到训练阶段结束。我们推测这种误分类代价高昂，因为它会形成根深蒂固的偏置，而模型最终若要表现良好就必须将其逆转。我们通过定性（基于语言学理论与深度学习理论）与定量（基于数值测试）的混合评估来探查这一现象。定性评估表明只有部分BLiMP测试是有意义的指导。最后我们提出一个假设——大二元组假设：如果二元组统计在训练早期将模型偏置到错误区分上，学习过程就会表现出错误固着；并描述了在适当选择的BLiMP类别上测试该假设的方法。
AI.summary: 本文通过在BabyLM上训练OPT并用BLiMP按训练过程追踪“语法偏好”变化，发现模型在不少类别中会早早形成错误判断并长期维持。作者认为这类早期误分会导致后续需要付出更大代价去“翻盘”纠错，并指出BLiMP中只有部分测试对诊断学习机制真正有效。为解释机制，文章提出大二元组假设：早期由二元组共现统计带来的偏置可能驱动错误固着，并给出基于合适BLiMP类别的检验思路。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型；OPT；BabyLM；BLiMP；语法判断；训练动态；错误固着；二元组统计；语言学评测；归纳偏置
AI.comments: 贡献在于将“训练早期形成并持续的错误分离”作为现象系统化呈现，并提出可检验的机制假设（大二元组假设）。局限性方面：是否能推广到其他模型规模/架构、其他训练语料与更多语言任务，摘要中未提供证据；提出的“哪些BLiMP类别更有意义”的筛选准则与具体实验细节在摘要中也未展开。

title: Defensive Refusal Bias: How Safety Alignment Fails Cyber Defenders
summary: Safety alignment in large language models (LLMs), particularly for cybersecurity tasks, primarily focuses on preventing misuse. While this approach reduces direct harm, it obscures a complementary failure mode: denial of assistance to legitimate defenders. We study Defensive Refusal Bias -- the tendency of safety-tuned frontier LLMs to refuse assistance for authorized defensive cybersecurity tasks when those tasks include similar language to an offensive cyber task. Based on 2,390 real-world examples from the National Collegiate Cyber Defense Competition (NCCDC), we find that LLMs refuse defensive requests containing security-sensitive keywords at $2.72\times$ the rate of semantically equivalent neutral requests ($p < 0.001$). The highest refusal rates occur in the most operationally critical tasks: system hardening (43.8%) and malware analysis (34.3%). Interestingly, explicit authorization, where the user directly instructs the model that they have authority to complete the target task, increases refusal rates, suggesting models interpret justifications as adversarial rather than exculpatory. These findings are urgent for interactive use and critical for autonomous defensive agents, which cannot rephrase refused queries or retry. Our findings suggest that current LLM cybersecurity alignment relies on semantic similarity to harmful content rather than reasoning about intent or authorization. We call for mitigations that analyze intent to maximize defensive capabilities while still preventing harmful compliance.

AI.title_translation: 防御性拒绝偏差：安全对齐如何让网络防御者失灵
AI.tldr: 研究发现：安全对齐后的前沿LLM会因“防御请求”用词与攻击任务相似而过度拒答；在2,390个真实防御场景样本中，含安全敏感词的防御请求拒绝率是语义等价中性表述的2.72倍，且“明确授权”反而提升拒绝率，表明模型更依赖语义相似度而非意图/授权推理。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM网络安全对齐主要防止滥用，但可能导致另一种失效：对合法防御者的正当协助被拒绝，从而影响交互式使用与自主防御代理的可用性与安全性。
AI.method: 基于NCCDC（美国大学生网络防御竞赛）的2,390个真实世界示例，比较安全调优LLM对包含安全敏感关键词的防御请求与语义等价的中性请求的拒绝率；并分析不同任务类型及“显式授权”提示对拒绝率的影响，给出统计显著性（p < 0.001）。
AI.result: LLM对含安全敏感关键词的防御请求的拒绝率是语义等价中性请求的2.72倍（p < 0.001）；拒绝率最高的关键任务为系统加固43.8%、恶意软件分析34.3%；显式授权（声明有权限执行任务）会提高拒绝率，暗示模型将“解释/辩护”视为对抗性信号而非免责信息。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM网络安全对齐更依赖与有害内容的语义相似度来触发拒绝，而非对用户意图与授权进行推理；需要引入能够分析意图的缓解措施，在抑制恶意合规的同时最大化对合法防御的支持。
AI.translation: 本文研究“防御性拒绝偏差”：安全对齐后的前沿大模型在面对已授权的防御性网络安全任务时，只要措辞与进攻性任务相近就更容易拒绝协助。基于NCCDC的2,390个真实例子，模型对包含安全敏感关键词的防御请求的拒绝率是语义等价中性表述的2.72倍（p<0.001）。拒绝最严重的往往是最关键的操作任务，如系统加固（43.8%）与恶意软件分析（34.3%）。此外，用户明确声明自己有权执行任务反而会提升拒绝率，表明模型可能将这类“授权说明”解读为对抗性辩解。该问题对交互使用很紧迫，对无法改写或重试的自主防御代理尤为致命。作者认为当前对齐主要基于语义相似而非意图/授权推理，并呼吁采用能识别意图的缓解方法，在防止有害输出的同时提升防御能力。
AI.summary: 论文指出网络安全场景中的LLM安全对齐存在“误伤防御者”的系统性偏差。作者用NCCDC 2,390条真实防御任务请求，量化了含安全敏感词的防御请求更易触发拒绝（2.72倍），且在系统加固、恶意软件分析等高关键任务上最严重。更反直觉的是，显式授权提示会进一步增加拒绝，显示模型倾向把授权解释当作可疑辩解。文章据此推断现有对齐主要做语义层面的有害相似性判断，缺乏对意图与授权的推理，并提出需要面向“意图识别”的缓解策略以兼顾安全与防御可用性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型；安全对齐；网络安全；拒绝偏差；防御性拒绝；意图推理；授权；系统加固；恶意软件分析；NCCDC
AI.comments: 优点：使用竞赛来源的真实防御样本并进行统计检验，量化了防御场景拒绝的规模与任务分布；指出“显式授权反增拒绝”的关键现象，对自主代理风险提示明确。局限：摘要未说明涉及哪些具体LLM、拒绝判定标准、实验控制细节与中性改写构造方法，因而外推性与可复现性细节需看正文。

title: CARE: Towards Clinical Accountability in Multi-Modal Medical Reasoning with an Evidence-Grounded Agentic Framework
summary: Large visual language models (VLMs) have shown strong multi-modal medical reasoning ability, but most operate as end-to-end black boxes, diverging from clinicians' evidence-based, staged workflows and hindering clinical accountability. Complementarily, expert visual grounding models can accurately localize regions of interest (ROIs), providing explicit, reliable evidence that improves both reasoning accuracy and trust. In this paper, we introduce CARE, advancing Clinical Accountability in multi-modal medical Reasoning with an Evidence-grounded agentic framework. Unlike existing approaches that couple grounding and reasoning within a single generalist model, CARE decomposes the task into coordinated sub-modules to reduce shortcut learning and hallucination: a compact VLM proposes relevant medical entities; an expert entity-referring segmentation model produces pixel-level ROI evidence; and a grounded VLM reasons over the full image augmented by ROI hints. The VLMs are optimized with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards to align answers with supporting evidence. Furthermore, a VLM coordinator plans tool invocation and reviews evidence-answer consistency, providing agentic control and final verification. Evaluated on standard medical VQA benchmarks, our CARE-Flow (coordinator-free) improves average accuracy by 10.9% over the same size (10B) state-of-the-art (SOTA). With dynamic planning and answer review, our CARE-Coord yields a further gain, outperforming the heavily pre-trained SOTA by 5.2%. Our experiments demonstrate that an agentic framework that emulates clinical workflows, incorporating decoupled specialized models and explicit evidence, yields more accurate and accountable medical AI. Project page: https://xypb.github.io/CARE-Project-Page/

AI.title_translation: CARE：通过证据扎根的智能体框架实现多模态医学推理的临床可追责性
AI.tldr: 提出CARE，将医学VQA分解为“实体提出—像素级ROI证据分割—基于证据的推理—协调器规划与一致性审查”，并用可验证奖励的强化学习对齐证据与答案，在标准医学VQA上显著提升准确率与可追责性。
AI.motivation: 现有大视觉语言模型虽具多模态医学推理能力，但多为端到端黑箱，偏离临床循证、分阶段工作流，导致难以进行临床可追责；同时需要更可靠的显式证据来减少捷径学习与幻觉并提升信任。
AI.method: CARE采用证据扎根的智能体式分解框架：1) 紧凑VLM提出相关医学实体；2) 专家级实体指代分割模型输出像素级ROI证据；3) 以ROI提示增强的扎根VLM在全图上推理；4) 用“可验证奖励”的强化学习优化VLM，使答案与证据一致；5) 额外的VLM协调器负责工具调用规划并审查证据-答案一致性，进行最终验证（CARE-Coord），另有无协调器版本CARE-Flow。
AI.result: 在标准医学VQA基准上：CARE-Flow（无协调器）相较同尺寸（10B）的SOTA平均准确率提升10.9%；引入动态规划与答案审查后，CARE-Coord进一步提升，并超过“重度预训练”的SOTA 5.2%。
AI.conclusion: 模拟临床工作流的智能体框架，通过解耦专用模型并引入显式、可定位的证据，可在医学多模态推理中同时提升准确性与临床可追责性。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 论文提出CARE框架以解决医学VLM黑箱推理难以追责的问题。CARE将任务拆成实体提名、ROI像素级证据生成与基于证据的推理，并通过可验证奖励的强化学习对齐“答案-证据”。在此之上，协调器实现工具调用规划与一致性复核，形成端到端的证据链验证流程。实验在医学VQA基准上取得显著准确率提升，并表明该循证、分阶段的智能体式设计能减少幻觉、提升可信与可追责。
AI.keywords: 多模态医学推理; 医学VQA; 视觉语言模型(VLM); 临床可追责性; 证据扎根; ROI定位; 实体指代分割; 智能体框架; 强化学习; 可验证奖励; 幻觉抑制
AI.comments: 优势：通过“提出实体-分割证据-证据推理-协调审查”的模块化设计贴近临床循证流程，并以像素级ROI作为显式证据提升可解释与可追责；性能提升幅度较大且包含与同尺寸/重预训练SOTA的对比。局限：摘要未说明所用基准数据集名称、具体奖励设计/验证机制细节、计算成本与延迟、以及对可追责性的定量评估指标。

title: ToolRLA: Multiplicative Reward Decomposition for Tool-Integrated Agents
summary: Tool-integrated agents that interleave reasoning with API calls are promising for complex tasks, yet aligning them for high-stakes, domain-specific deployment remains challenging: existing reinforcement learning approaches rely on coarse binary rewards that cannot distinguish tool selection errors from malformed parameters. We present ToolRLA, a three-stage post-training pipeline (SFT -> GRPO -> DPO) for domain-specific tool agents. The core contribution is a fine-grained reward function with multiplicative correctness decomposition spanning four dimensions -- format validity, tool selection, parameter accuracy, and regulatory compliance -- that encodes domain priority orderings as inductive biases in the reward landscape. Deployed on a financial advisory copilot (80+ advisors, 1,200+ daily queries), ToolRLA achieves over three months: a 47% improvement in task completion rate (62%->91%), a 63% reduction in tool invocation errors (38%->14%), and a 93% reduction in regulatory violations (12%->0.8%), within sub-2-second latency. Ablation studies show the multiplicative reward design accounts for 7 percentage points of improvement over additive alternatives. Generalization is further validated on ToolBench and API-Bank.

AI.title_translation: ToolRLA：面向工具集成智能体的乘法式奖励分解
AI.tldr: 提出ToolRLA三阶段后训练流程，并用覆盖格式、工具选择、参数与合规四维度的乘法式细粒度奖励函数对工具型智能体对齐；在金融顾问Copilot线上显著提升完成率、降低工具错误与合规违规，并在ToolBench与API-Bank验证泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有用于工具调用智能体的强化学习对齐多依赖粗粒度二元奖励，无法区分“选错工具”和“参数填写错误”等细节，导致在高风险、强监管的领域落地对齐困难。
AI.method: ToolRLA：三阶段后训练管线（SFT -> GRPO -> DPO）。核心为细粒度奖励的乘法正确性分解，包含四个维度：格式有效性、工具选择、参数准确性、监管合规；并将领域优先级顺序作为归纳偏置编码进奖励景观。并通过消融与在ToolBench、API-Bank上的评测验证设计有效性与泛化。
AI.result: 在金融投顾Copilot线上部署（80+顾问、日查询1,200+），三个月内：任务完成率提升47%（62%->91%）；工具调用错误降低63%（38%->14%）；监管违规降低93%（12%->0.8%）；端到端延迟<2秒。消融显示乘法式奖励较加法式替代方案额外带来约7个百分点提升。并在ToolBench与API-Bank上进一步验证泛化。
AI.conclusion: 通过在后训练中引入四维乘法分解的细粒度奖励并结合SFT/GRPO/DPO流程，可更准确地区分并纠正工具使用中的不同错误类型，显著提升任务成功率与合规性，且具备跨基准的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 工具集成智能体通过在推理过程中穿插API调用，有望完成复杂任务，但要将其对齐以用于高风险、领域特定的部署仍具挑战：现有强化学习方法依赖粗粒度二元奖励，无法区分工具选择错误与参数不合法等问题。我们提出ToolRLA，一种面向领域工具智能体的三阶段后训练流程（SFT -> GRPO -> DPO）。其核心贡献是一个细粒度奖励函数，采用跨四个维度的乘法式正确性分解——格式有效性、工具选择、参数准确性与监管合规——并将领域优先级顺序作为归纳偏置编码进奖励景观。在金融投顾Copilot（80+顾问、日查询1,200+）上部署三个月，ToolRLA实现：任务完成率提升47%（62%->91%），工具调用错误降低63%（38%->14%），监管违规降低93%（12%->0.8%），同时延迟低于2秒。消融研究表明乘法奖励设计相对加法替代方案贡献了额外7个百分点的提升。其泛化能力也在ToolBench与API-Bank上得到进一步验证。
AI.summary: 论文面向“推理+工具/API调用”的智能体对齐问题，指出二元奖励过粗导致无法定位工具使用失败的具体原因。作者提出ToolRLA的三阶段后训练（SFT/GRPO/DPO），并设计四维度的乘法式奖励分解，将格式、工具选择、参数与合规按领域优先级耦合进奖励，从而更强约束关键错误。在线金融投顾系统的大规模真实流量结果显示其在完成率、工具调用正确性与合规性上均显著改善且满足低延迟；消融与公开基准进一步支持乘法分解的增益与泛化。
AI.keywords: 工具调用智能体; 强化学习对齐; 后训练; 奖励函数设计; 乘法式奖励分解; GRPO; DPO; SFT; 金融投顾; 合规性; ToolBench; API-Bank
AI.comments: 优点：将错误类型细分并用乘法耦合，能表达“合规优先”等领域偏好，且提供真实线上部署指标与消融对比。局限：GRPO细节、奖励权重/阈值设定、数据与标注方式、以及在其他强监管领域的可迁移性在摘要中未展开。

title: SEED-SET: Scalable Evolving Experimental Design for System-level Ethical Testing
comments: 10 main pages along with Appendix containing additional results, manuscript accepted in ICLR 2026
summary: As autonomous systems such as drones, become increasingly deployed in high-stakes, human-centric domains, it is critical to evaluate the ethical alignment since failure to do so imposes imminent danger to human lives, and long term bias in decision-making. Automated ethical benchmarking of these systems is understudied due to the lack of ubiquitous, well-defined metrics for evaluation, and stakeholder-specific subjectivity, which cannot be modeled analytically. To address these challenges, we propose SEED-SET, a Bayesian experimental design framework that incorporates domain-specific objective evaluations, and subjective value judgments from stakeholders. SEED-SET models both evaluation types separately with hierarchical Gaussian Processes, and uses a novel acquisition strategy to propose interesting test candidates based on learnt qualitative preferences and objectives that align with the stakeholder preferences. We validate our approach for ethical benchmarking of autonomous agents on two applications and find our method to perform the best. Our method provides an interpretable and efficient trade-off between exploration and exploitation, by generating up to $2\times$ optimal test candidates compared to baselines, with $1.25\times$ improvement in coverage of high dimensional search spaces.
comment: 10 main pages along with Appendix containing additional results, manuscript accepted in ICLR 2026

AI.title_translation: SEED-SET：用于系统级伦理测试的可扩展演化实验设计
AI.tldr: 提出SEED-SET贝叶斯实验设计框架，将客观领域评估与利益相关者主观价值判断分开建模（分层高斯过程），并用新的采集策略生成符合偏好且“有趣”的测试用例；在两项应用上优于基线，最多产生2×更优测试候选，并在高维空间覆盖率提升1.25×。
AI.motivation: 自主系统（如无人机）在高风险、人本领域部署增加，需要评估其伦理对齐；但自动化伦理基准测试研究不足，原因包括缺乏普适且定义明确的评估指标，以及不同利益相关者的主观性难以解析建模。
AI.method: SEED-SET：一种贝叶斯实验设计框架；将（1）领域特定的客观评估与（2）利益相关者的主观价值判断分开，用分层高斯过程（Hierarchical Gaussian Processes）建模；并提出新的采集（acquisition）策略，基于学习到的定性偏好与目标，推荐与利益相关者偏好一致的“有趣”测试候选，实现可解释的探索-利用权衡。
AI.result: 在两个自主智能体伦理基准测试应用上验证，方法表现最好；相较基线最多生成2×最优测试候选；在高维搜索空间的覆盖率提升1.25×；同时提供高效且可解释的探索与利用折中。
AI.conclusion: SEED-SET能在考虑客观指标与主观偏好的前提下，扩展且高效地生成系统级伦理测试用例，用于自主系统的自动化伦理基准测试，并在实验中优于基线方法。
AI.translation: 随着无人机等自主系统在高风险、以人为中心的领域日益部署，评估其伦理对齐至关重要，因为忽视评估会对人命造成迫在眉睫的危险，并在长期决策中引入偏差。由于缺乏普适且明确定义的评估度量，以及无法用解析方式建模的、面向不同利益相关者的主观性，自动化的伦理基准测试仍研究不足。为应对这些挑战，我们提出SEED-SET：一种贝叶斯实验设计框架，融合领域特定的客观评估与来自利益相关者的主观价值判断。SEED-SET分别用分层高斯过程对两类评估进行建模，并提出一种新的采集策略，基于学习到的定性偏好与目标，提出与利益相关者偏好一致的、值得关注的测试候选。我们在两个应用中验证该方法用于自主智能体的伦理基准测试，并发现其性能最佳。该方法通过生成相较基线最多2倍的最优测试候选、并在高维搜索空间覆盖率上提升1.25倍，提供了可解释且高效的探索与利用权衡。
AI.summary: 论文针对自主系统伦理对齐评估中“指标不统一+主观偏好难建模”的痛点，提出SEED-SET贝叶斯实验设计框架：用分层高斯过程分别学习客观性能与主观价值判断，并通过新的采集策略在探索与利用间做可解释权衡，自动推荐符合利益相关者偏好的测试用例；在两项应用实验中整体优于基线，测试候选最优性与高维覆盖率均显著提升。
AI.keywords: 伦理基准测试, 自主系统, 贝叶斯实验设计, 分层高斯过程, 主观偏好建模, 采集函数, 探索-利用权衡, 高维搜索, 测试用例生成
AI.comments: 优点：将客观评估与主观价值判断解耦建模，贴合伦理测试的现实需求；强调可解释的探索-利用折中，并在高维覆盖与候选质量上给出量化增益。局限：抽象未说明两项应用的具体场景、数据规模、基线方法细节与统计显著性；“伦理对齐”客观指标的定义方式及利益相关者偏好采集流程未展开；1.25×覆盖率与2×最优候选的具体度量口径未在摘要中说明。

title: AdaPonderLM: Gated Pondering Language Models with Token-Wise Adaptive Depth
summary: Test-time scaling via recurrent/iterative Transformers enables large language models to spend more computation at inference, but most pretrained recurrent LMs run a fixed number of iterations, wasting compute on easy tokens and lacking token-wise adaptivity. Following the core idea of Adaptive Computation Time(ACT) and Early Exit(EE), we propose AdaPonderLM, a self-supervised recurrent language model that learns token-wise early exiting during pretraining without manually tuned per-token/per-layer pruning ratios. AdaPonderLM uses iteration-specific MLP gates with a monotonic halting mask to decide when each token stops recurring, and introduces a KV reuse mechanism that reuses cached key/value states for halted tokens, ensuring train--test consistency and practical acceleration. Across Pythia backbones from 70M to 410M (pretraining) and up to 2.8B (continued pretraining), AdaPonderLM reduces inference compute at about 10% while maintaining comparable language modeling perplexity and competitive downstream accuracy. Our analysis shows the learned gates allocate more computation to high-NLL (hard) tokens, exhibiting adaptive computation time behavior in a fully self-supervised setting. Meanwhile, under iso-FLOPs, the learned halting policy consistently outperforms fixed pruning, showing AdaPonderLM allocates compute to the right tokens rather than just reducing average depth.

AI.title_translation: AdaPonderLM：具备逐Token自适应深度的门控“思考式”语言模型
AI.tldr: 提出AdaPonderLM，在预训练中学习逐token的早停/自适应迭代深度，并通过KV复用实现一致且可加速的推理；在约降低10%推理计算量的同时保持相近困惑度与下游表现，并在同等FLOPs下优于固定剪枝策略。
AI.motivation: 现有通过循环/迭代Transformer进行测试时算力扩展的方法通常固定迭代次数，导致对“容易”的token浪费计算且缺乏逐token自适应；同时希望避免手动调每token/每层剪枝比例。
AI.method: AdaPonderLM：自监督的循环语言模型；在每次迭代使用迭代特定的MLP门控，并配合单调的停止(mask)决定每个token何时停止递归（早退出）；引入KV reuse机制，对已停止的token复用缓存的key/value状态以保证训练-测试一致性并带来实际加速。
AI.result: 在Pythia骨干上（预训练70M–410M，继续预训练最高2.8B），推理计算量约降低10%，同时保持可比的语言建模困惑度与有竞争力的下游准确率；门控会为高NLL（更难）token分配更多计算；在iso-FLOPs条件下，学习到的停止策略稳定优于固定剪枝。
AI.conclusion: AdaPonderLM能在完全自监督的预训练中学得逐token自适应计算时间/早停策略，通过KV复用实现实用加速，并在不显著损失性能的情况下减少推理计算；其停止策略在同等计算预算下优于固定剪枝，说明其将计算分配给“正确”的token。

title: Contractor-Expander and Universal Inverse Optimal Positive Nonlinear Control
summary: For general control-affine nonlinear systems in the positive orthant, and with positive controls, we show how strict CLFs can be utilized for inverse optimal stabilization. Conventional ``LgV'' inverse optimal feedback laws, for systems with unconstrained states and controls, assume sign-unconstrained inputs and input penalties that are class-K in the input magnitude, hence symmetric about zero. Such techniques do not extend to positive-state-and-control systems. Major customizations are needed, and introduced in this paper, for positive systems where highly asymmetric (or unconventionally symmetric) costs not only on the state but also on control are necessary. With the predator-prey positive-state positive-input benchmark system as inspiration, using a strict CLF built in our previous paper, we prototype two general inverse optimal methodological frameworks that employ particular ``contractor and expander functions.'' One framework (A) employs a triple consisting of a CLF, a stabilizing feedback, and an expander, whereas the other framework (B) employs a pair of a CLF and a contractor function. Both frameworks yield inverse optimal stabilizer constructions, on positive orthants of arbitrary dimensions. A stronger construction results from a stronger CLF condition. Biological interpretation for the predator-prey model illuminates that such inverse optimal control constructions are bio-ecologically meaningful. In addition to general frameworks, we present two fully explicit designs: two Sontag-like universal formulae for stabilization of positive-orthant systems by positive feedback, one of them with inverse optimality.

AI.title_translation: 承包器-扩张器与通用逆最优正非线性控制
AI.tldr: 针对正正交象限中的控制仿射非线性系统（状态与控制均为正），本文基于严格CLF构造两类含“contractor/expander函数”的逆最优稳定化框架，并给出两种显式的类Sontag通用稳定化正反馈公式（其中一种具逆最优性）。
AI.motivation: 传统基于“LgV”的逆最优反馈适用于状态/控制不受符号约束、且控制代价对输入幅值为类K并关于0对称的情形；但在状态与控制都必须为正的系统中，该对称代价与符号无约束假设不成立，因而需要为正系统引入重大定制，包括对状态与控制采用高度非对称（或非常规对称）的代价结构。以捕食-被捕食正状态正输入模型为启发，推动构建适用于任意维正正交象限的逆最优稳定化方法。
AI.method: 以先前工作构造的严格CLF为基础，提出两套通用逆最优方法框架并引入特定“contractor与expander函数”：(A) 使用三元组{CLF、稳定化反馈、expander}进行构造；(B) 使用二元组{CLF、contractor}进行构造。两框架均针对一般控制仿射非线性系统、在正正交象限内、且控制取正的约束下，给出逆最优稳定化器。并在此基础上进一步给出两种完全显式的设计：两条类Sontag的通用公式，用于以正反馈稳定正正交象限系统，其中一条同时满足逆最优性。
AI.result: 提出并证明两套（A/B）逆最优稳定化构造框架，适用于任意维正正交象限的正状态/正控制控制仿射非线性系统；指出更强的CLF条件可导出更强的构造结果；给出两种显式类Sontag通用稳定化正反馈公式，其中一种具备逆最优性质；并通过捕食-被捕食模型给出生物学解释，说明所构造的逆最优控制在生物-生态学上具有意义。
AI.conclusion: 严格CLF可在正状态与正控制约束下用于逆最优稳定化，但需对代价与构造方式做针对正系统的关键定制；通过引入contractor/expander函数的两类框架可以在任意维正正交象限内实现逆最优稳定化，并可获得显式的类Sontag正反馈通用公式（含逆最优版本），且在捕食-被捕食情境下具有可解释的生物生态意义。

title: Mind the Way You Select Negative Texts: Pursuing the Distance Consistency in OOD Detection with VLMs
comments: Accepted by the main track of CVPR 2026
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection seeks to identify samples from unknown classes, a critical capability for deploying machine learning models in open-world scenarios. Recent research has demonstrated that Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can effectively leverage their multi-modal representations for OOD detection. However, current methods often incorporate intra-modal distance during OOD detection, such as comparing negative texts with ID labels or comparing test images with image proxies. This design paradigm creates an inherent inconsistency against the inter-modal distance that CLIP-like VLMs are optimized for, potentially leading to suboptimal performance. To address this limitation, we propose InterNeg, a simple yet effective framework that systematically utilizes consistent inter-modal distance enhancement from textual and visual perspectives. From the textual perspective, we devise an inter-modal criterion for selecting negative texts. From the visual perspective, we dynamically identify high-confidence OOD images and invert them into the textual space, generating extra negative text embeddings guided by inter-modal distance. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our approach. Notably, our InterNeg achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing works, with a 3.47% reduction in FPR95 on the large-scale ImageNet benchmark and a 5.50% improvement in AUROC on the challenging Near-OOD benchmark.
comment: Accepted by the main track of CVPR 2026

AI.title_translation: 注意你选择负文本的方式：在基于VLM的OOD检测中追求距离一致性
AI.tldr: 提出InterNeg框架，通过在文本与视觉两侧强化与CLIP一致的跨模态距离来改进OOD检测；在ImageNet上FPR95降低3.47%，在Near-OOD上AUROC提升5.50%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VLM的OOD检测方法常引入单模态（intra-modal）距离（如负文本与ID标签对比、测试图像与图像代理对比），这与CLIP类VLM优化的跨模态（inter-modal）距离目标不一致，可能导致性能不佳。

AI.conclusion: 通过一致地利用并增强跨模态距离、并在负文本选择与由OOD图像生成负文本嵌入方面进行改进，可显著提升基于VLM的OOD检测性能并达到最新最优结果。

title: Cross-Family Speculative Prefill: Training-Free Long-Context Compression with Small Draft Models
summary: Prompt length is a major bottleneck in agentic large language model (LLM) workloads, where repeated inference steps and multi-call loops incur substantial prefill cost. Recent work on speculative prefill demonstrates that attention-based token importance estimation can enable training-free prompt compression, but this assumes the existence of a draft model that shares the same tokenizer as the target model. In practice, however, agentic pipelines frequently employ models without any smaller in-family draft model. In this work, we study cross-family speculative prefill, where a lightweight draft model from one model family is used to perform prompt compression for a target model from a different family. Using the same speculative prefill mechanism as prior work, we evaluate a range of cross-family draft-target combinations, including Qwen, LLaMA, and DeepSeek models. Across a broad diversity of tasks, we find that attention-based token importance estimation transfers reliably across different model families despite differences in model architectures and tokenizers between draft and target models. Cross-model prompt compression largely retains 90~100% of full-prompt baseline performance and, in some cases, slightly improves accuracy due to denoising effects, while delivering substantial reductions in time to first token (TTFT). These results suggest that speculative prefill depends mainly on task priors and semantic structure, thus serving as a generalizable prompt compression primitive. We discuss the implications of our findings for agentic systems, where repeated long-context inference and heterogeneous model stacks make cross-model prompt compression both necessary and practical.

AI.title_translation: 跨家族推测性预填充：使用小型草稿模型的免训练长上下文压缩
AI.tldr: 提出并验证“跨模型家族”的推测性预填充：用不同家族的小草稿模型做注意力重要性估计来压缩提示词，在多任务上基本保持性能（约90~100%）同时显著降低首 token 时间（TTFT）。
AI.motivation: 在智能体式LLM工作负载中，长提示词与多轮/多次调用导致预填充成本很高；现有推测性预填充方法通常要求草稿模型与目标模型同家族且共享tokenizer，但真实流水线常缺少同家族的小草稿模型，因此需要研究跨家族可行性。
AI.method: 研究“跨家族推测性预填充”：沿用既有推测性预填充机制，使用来自不同模型家族的轻量草稿模型对提示词进行基于注意力的token重要性估计并压缩，然后将压缩后的提示输入目标模型；评估多种跨家族草稿-目标组合（Qwen、LLaMA、DeepSeek等）并覆盖多样任务。
AI.result: 发现基于注意力的token重要性估计在不同模型家族间可可靠迁移，尽管架构与tokenizer不同；跨模型提示压缩在广泛任务上大体保留全提示基线约90~100%的性能，部分场景因“去噪”效应略有提升；同时显著降低TTFT。
AI.conclusion: 推测性预填充主要依赖任务先验与语义结构，可作为一种通用、可泛化的提示压缩原语；在需要反复长上下文推理且模型栈异构的智能体系统中，跨模型提示压缩既必要也实用。
AI.translation: 提示长度是智能体式大语言模型（LLM）工作负载中的主要瓶颈，其中重复的推理步骤与多次调用循环会带来大量预填充成本。近期关于推测性预填充的工作表明，基于注意力的token重要性估计可以实现免训练的提示压缩，但这通常假设存在与目标模型共享同一tokenizer的草稿模型。然而在实践中，智能体流水线经常使用缺少同家族更小草稿模型的模型组合。本文研究跨家族推测性预填充：使用来自某一模型家族的轻量草稿模型，为不同家族的目标模型执行提示压缩。我们沿用先前工作的推测性预填充机制，评估了多种跨家族草稿-目标组合，包括Qwen、LLaMA与DeepSeek模型。在多样任务上，我们发现尽管草稿与目标模型在架构与tokenizer上存在差异，基于注意力的token重要性估计仍能在不同模型家族间可靠迁移。跨模型提示压缩在很大程度上保留了全提示基线90~100%的性能，并且在某些情况下由于去噪效应还能略微提升准确率，同时显著降低首token时间（TTFT）。这些结果表明，推测性预填充主要依赖任务先验与语义结构，因此可作为一种可泛化的提示压缩原语。我们讨论了这些发现对智能体系统的意义：在需要反复长上下文推理且采用异构模型栈的场景中，跨模型提示压缩既必要又可行。
AI.summary: 本文针对智能体工作流中“长上下文+多次调用”导致的预填充开销，提出并系统评估跨模型家族的推测性预填充方案：用任意轻量草稿模型（即使与目标模型tokenizer/架构不同）进行注意力重要性估计来筛选/压缩提示词，再交给目标模型推理。实验覆盖Qwen、LLaMA、DeepSeek等多种跨家族组合与多类任务，结果显示重要性估计具有良好跨家族迁移性，压缩后性能通常保持在全提示的90~100%，偶尔还能因去噪略升，同时显著缩短TTFT，表明该方法更依赖语义结构与任务先验而非模型同源性，适合异构智能体系统落地。
AI.keywords: 推测性预填充; 提示词压缩; 长上下文; 免训练; 注意力重要性; 跨模型家族; tokenizer差异; 草稿模型; 时间到首token(TTFT); 智能体系统
AI.comments: 贡献点：将推测性预填充从“同家族草稿-目标”推广到跨家族设置，并实证其可迁移性与TTFT收益。局限与细节：未在摘要中说明具体压缩率、TTFT降低幅度、任务/数据集、评价指标细节与实现开销；“去噪”提升的条件与机制也未展开。

title: BrandFusion: A Multi-Agent Framework for Seamless Brand Integration in Text-to-Video Generation
summary: The rapid advancement of text-to-video (T2V) models has revolutionized content creation, yet their commercial potential remains largely untapped. We introduce, for the first time, the task of seamless brand integration in T2V: automatically embedding advertiser brands into prompt-generated videos while preserving semantic fidelity to user intent. This task confronts three core challenges: maintaining prompt fidelity, ensuring brand recognizability, and achieving contextually natural integration. To address them, we propose BrandFusion, a novel multi-agent framework comprising two synergistic phases. In the offline phase (advertiser-facing), we construct a Brand Knowledge Base by probing model priors and adapting to novel brands via lightweight fine-tuning. In the online phase (user-facing), five agents jointly refine user prompts through iterative refinement, leveraging the shared knowledge base and real-time contextual tracking to ensure brand visibility and semantic alignment. Experiments on 18 established and 2 custom brands across multiple state-of-the-art T2V models demonstrate that BrandFusion significantly outperforms baselines in semantic preservation, brand recognizability, and integration naturalness. Human evaluations further confirm higher user satisfaction, establishing a practical pathway for sustainable T2V monetization.

AI.title_translation: BrandFusion：用于文本到视频生成中无缝品牌植入的多智能体框架
AI.tldr: 提出在文本到视频生成中“无缝品牌植入”新任务，并给出两阶段多智能体框架BrandFusion，通过离线构建品牌知识库与在线多智能体迭代改写提示词，实现兼顾语义一致、品牌可识别与自然融合的品牌植入，实验与人工评测均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管文本到视频（T2V）模型发展迅速，但其商业化变现潜力尚未充分释放；需要一种能在不偏离用户意图的前提下，将广告品牌自动、自然地融入生成视频的机制。
AI.method: BrandFusion多智能体两阶段框架：1）离线（面向广告主）：通过探测模型先验构建Brand Knowledge Base，并用轻量级微调适配新品牌；2）在线（面向用户）：由5个智能体在共享知识库与实时上下文跟踪的支持下，对用户提示词进行迭代式联合改写与精炼，以提升品牌可见性并保持语义对齐与融合自然。
AI.result: 在多种SOTA T2V模型上，对18个既有品牌与2个自定义品牌的实验表明，BrandFusion在语义保真（semantic preservation）、品牌可识别性（brand recognizability）与融合自然性（integration naturalness）方面显著优于基线；人工评测显示更高的用户满意度。
AI.conclusion: BrandFusion为T2V中的可持续商业化/变现提供了可行路径：在保持用户意图语义一致的同时实现可识别且自然的品牌植入。

title: LaTeX Compilation: Challenges in the Era of LLMs
summary: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly assist scientific writing, limitations and the significant token cost of TeX become more and more visible. This paper analyzes TeX's fundamental defects in compilation and user experience design to illustrate its limitations on compilation efficiency, generated semantics, error localization, and tool ecosystem in the era of LLMs. As an alternative, Mogan STEM, a WYSIWYG structured editor, is introduced. Mogan outperforms TeX in the above aspects by its efficient data structure, fast rendering, and on-demand plugin loading. Extensive experiments are conducted to verify the benefits on compilation/rendering time and performance in LLM tasks. Furthermore, we show that due to Mogan's lower information entropy, it is more efficient to use .tmu (the document format of Mogan) to fine-tune LLMs than TeX. Therefore, we launch an appeal for larger experiments on LLM training using the .tmu format.

AI.title_translation: LaTeX 编译：大语言模型时代的挑战

title: Kraken: Higher-order EM Side-Channel Attacks on DNNs in Near and Far Field
summary: The multi-million dollar investment required for modern machine learning (ML) has made large ML models a prime target for theft. In response, the field of model stealing has emerged. Attacks based on physical side-channel information have shown that DNN model extraction is feasible, even on CUDA Cores in a GPU. For the first time, our work demonstrates parameter extraction on the specialized GPU's Tensor Core units, most commonly used GPU units nowadays due to their superior performance, via near-field physical side-channel attacks. Previous work targeted only the general-purpose CUDA Cores in the GPU, the functional units that have been part of the GPU since its inception. Our method is tailored to the GPU architecture to accurately estimate energy consumption and derive efficient attacks via Correlation Power Analysis (CPA). Furthermore, we provide an exploratory analysis of hyperparameter and weight leakage from LLMs in far field and demonstrate that the GPU's electromagnetic radiation leaks even 100 cm away through a glass obstacle.

AI.title_translation: Kraken：针对近场与远场的DNN高阶电磁（EM）侧信道攻击
AI.tldr: 提出首个针对GPU Tensor Core的近场电磁侧信道参数提取方法，并探索性证明远场（100 cm、隔玻璃）条件下GPU电磁辐射仍会泄露LLM权重/超参数相关信息。
AI.motivation: 现代大型机器学习模型训练投入巨大，导致模型盗窃风险高；现有物理侧信道模型窃取主要集中在GPU通用CUDA Core，缺乏对如今更常用、更关键的Tensor Core的参数提取研究。
AI.method: 面向GPU架构定制能耗估计方法，利用近场物理侧信道采集电磁/能耗相关信号，通过相关功耗分析（CPA）实施高阶侧信道攻击以提取Tensor Core上运行的DNN参数；另外对远场场景进行探索性分析，评估LLM超参数与权重泄露，并在存在玻璃障碍、距离100 cm条件下验证可观测泄露。
AI.result: 首次展示可通过近场电磁侧信道对GPU Tensor Core上的DNN进行参数提取；并表明GPU电磁辐射在远场100 cm且隔玻璃时仍可被观测到，存在对LLM超参数与权重信息的泄露迹象（探索性结果）。
AI.conclusion: GPU Tensor Core同样会产生可被高阶EM侧信道利用的可提取信息，模型窃取威胁从CUDA Core扩展到Tensor Core；同时远场条件下也可能发生信息泄露，风险范围可能超出近距离物理接触场景。
AI.translation: 现代机器学习（ML）所需的数百万美元投入使大型ML模型成为盗窃的主要目标。为此，模型窃取领域应运而生。基于物理侧信道信息的攻击已表明，即使在GPU的CUDA Core上也能实现DNN模型提取。我们首次展示：通过近场物理侧信道攻击，可以在专用GPU的Tensor Core单元上进行参数提取；由于其性能优越，Tensor Core是当今最常使用的GPU计算单元。以往工作只针对GPU中的通用CUDA Core（自GPU诞生以来就存在的功能单元）。我们的方法针对GPU架构进行了定制，以准确估计能量消耗，并通过相关功耗分析（CPA）推导出高效攻击。此外，我们对远场条件下LLM的超参数与权重泄露进行了探索性分析，并证明GPU的电磁辐射即使在100厘米外、穿过玻璃障碍仍会泄露信息。
AI.summary: 论文提出Kraken侧信道攻击框架，将DNN模型窃取从GPU CUDA Core扩展到更关键的Tensor Core：通过面向GPU架构的能耗建模与CPA相关分析，在近场电磁侧信道下实现Tensor Core参数提取；同时进行远场可行性探索，发现100 cm且隔玻璃仍能观测到GPU电磁泄露，提示LLM权重/超参数存在潜在泄露风险。
AI.keywords: 模型窃取, 电磁侧信道, 高阶攻击, 相关功耗分析, CPA, GPU, Tensor Core, CUDA Core, 近场攻击, 远场泄露, LLM, 参数提取, 权重泄露, 超参数泄露
AI.comments: 抽象未说明具体攻击假设（如是否需要已知输入/明文模型）、采样设备与频段、提取参数的粒度与成功率/误差、适用的网络结构与规模、远场对抗的可重复性与定量指标，以及防御与缓解措施；远场部分被描述为“探索性分析”，结论力度可能有限。

title: No Memorization, No Detection: Output Distribution-Based Contamination Detection in Small Language Models
summary: CDD, or Contamination Detection via output Distribution, identifies data contamination by measuring the peakedness of a model's sampled outputs. We study the conditions under which this approach succeeds and fails on small language models ranging from 70M to 410M parameters. Using controlled contamination experiments on GSM8K, HumanEval, and MATH, we find that CDD's effectiveness depends critically on whether fine-tuning produces verbatim memorization. In the majority of conditions we test, CDD performs at chance level even when the data is verifiably contaminated and detectable by simpler methods. We show that probability-based methods, specifically perplexity and Min-k\% Prob, outperform CDD in all conditions where any method exceeds chance, suggesting that CDD's peakedness-based approach is insufficient for contamination detection in small language models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sela-Omer/Contamination-Detection-Small-LM

AI.title_translation: 不记忆就无法检测：基于输出分布的“小语言模型”数据污染检测
AI.tldr: 作者评估CDD（通过输出分布峰度检测污染）在70M–410M小语言模型上的有效性，发现其多数情况下接近随机猜测；基于概率的困惑度与Min-k% Prob在所有有效场景中都优于CDD，说明仅靠“峰度”不足以做小模型污染检测。
AI.motivation: 检验CDD这一“基于输出分布峰度”的数据污染检测方法在小语言模型上何时有效、何时失效，并与更简单的概率/困惑度类检测方法对比其可靠性。
AI.method: 在70M到410M参数的小语言模型上进行受控污染实验；数据集包括GSM8K、HumanEval和MATH；以模型采样输出的“峰度(peakedness)”作为CDD信号评估污染检测性能，并与概率型方法（perplexity、Min-k% Prob）进行对比；同时分析其是否依赖微调产生逐字记忆(verbatim memorization)。
AI.result: CDD的效果关键取决于微调是否产生逐字记忆；在作者测试的大多数条件下，即使数据可验证地被污染且可被更简单方法检测到，CDD仍表现为随机水平；在任何方法能超过随机的条件下，perplexity与Min-k% Prob都在所有场景中优于CDD。
AI.conclusion: CDD基于输出分布峰度的思路不足以用于小语言模型的数据污染检测；更可靠的做法是采用概率/困惑度类方法（如perplexity与Min-k% Prob），尤其在不产生逐字记忆的污染情形下。
AI.translation: CDD（通过输出分布进行污染检测）通过测量模型采样输出的峰度来识别数据污染。我们研究了该方法在70M到410M参数的小语言模型上成功与失败的条件。通过在GSM8K、HumanEval和MATH上的受控污染实验，我们发现CDD的有效性关键取决于微调是否导致逐字记忆。在我们测试的大多数条件下，即使数据确实被污染且可通过更简单的方法检测到，CDD仍仅达到随机水平。我们表明，基于概率的方法，尤其是困惑度(perplexity)和Min-k% Prob，在所有“任何方法能超过随机”的条件下都优于CDD，这表明CDD的峰度方法不足以用于小语言模型的污染检测。代码地址：https://github.com/Sela-Omer/Contamination-Detection-Small-LM
AI.summary: 本文系统评估CDD在小参数语言模型上的污染检测能力，并通过多数据集受控污染实验揭示其核心前提：需要模型在微调后形成逐字记忆时CDD才可能奏效。总体结果显示CDD多数情况下与随机无异，而困惑度与Min-k% Prob等概率型指标在可检测场景中更稳健、更强，因而作者认为小模型污染检测不应依赖输出分布峰度信号。
AI.keywords: 数据污染检测, 小语言模型, 输出分布峰度, 逐字记忆, 困惑度, Min-k% Prob, GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, 受控污染实验
AI.comments: 优点：通过受控污染实验清晰定位CDD失效原因（依赖逐字记忆），并提供与概率法的全面对比与可复现代码。局限：仅覆盖70M–410M小模型与特定任务集；是否能推广到更大模型、不同训练范式或非逐字但强语义记忆的污染情形，摘要中未给出进一步结论。

title: CFG-Ctrl: Control-Based Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance
comments: Accepted by CVPR 2026; Project Page: https://hanyang-21.github.io/CFG-Ctrl
summary: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) has emerged as a central approach for enhancing semantic alignment in flow-based diffusion models. In this paper, we explore a unified framework called CFG-Ctrl, which reinterprets CFG as a control applied to the first-order continuous-time generative flow, using the conditional-unconditional discrepancy as an error signal to adjust the velocity field. From this perspective, we summarize vanilla CFG as a proportional controller (P-control) with fixed gain, and typical follow-up variants develop extended control-law designs derived from it. However, existing methods mainly rely on linear control, inherently leading to instability, overshooting, and degraded semantic fidelity especially on large guidance scales. To address this, we introduce Sliding Mode Control CFG (SMC-CFG), which enforces the generative flow toward a rapidly convergent sliding manifold. Specifically, we define an exponential sliding mode surface over the semantic prediction error and introduce a switching control term to establish nonlinear feedback-guided correction. Moreover, we provide a Lyapunov stability analysis to theoretically support finite-time convergence. Experiments across text-to-image generation models including Stable Diffusion 3.5, Flux, and Qwen-Image demonstrate that SMC-CFG outperforms standard CFG in semantic alignment and enhances robustness across a wide range of guidance scales. Project Page: https://hanyang-21.github.io/CFG-Ctrl
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026; Project Page: https://hanyang-21.github.io/CFG-Ctrl

AI.title_translation: CFG-Ctrl：基于控制的无分类器扩散引导
AI.tldr: 提出CFG-Ctrl框架将CFG解释为对连续时间生成流的控制；进一步给出基于滑模控制的SMC-CFG，用非线性切换控制提升大引导尺度下的稳定性与语义对齐，并给出李雅普诺夫稳定性与有限时间收敛分析，实验在多种T2I模型上优于标准CFG。
AI.motivation: 现有CFG及其变体多基于线性控制思想，在较大guidance scale时容易出现不稳定、过冲与语义保真度下降；需要一种更稳定、鲁棒的引导机制来提升语义对齐并避免大尺度退化。
AI.method: 提出统一框架CFG-Ctrl：将CFG重释为对一阶连续时间生成流(velocity field)施加控制，利用条件/无条件预测差作为误差信号来调整速度场；将原始CFG归纳为固定增益的比例控制(P-control)。在此基础上提出SMC-CFG：1) 基于语义预测误差定义指数型滑模面；2) 引入切换控制项形成非线性反馈校正，将生成流驱动到快速收敛的滑模流形；3) 通过李雅普诺夫稳定性分析证明有限时间收敛。
AI.result: 在文本到图像模型（Stable Diffusion 3.5、Flux、Qwen-Image）上的实验表明：SMC-CFG相较标准CFG在语义对齐上更好，并在更宽的guidance scale范围内更鲁棒（尤其在大尺度下更稳定）。
AI.conclusion: 将CFG视为控制问题可统一理解现有CFG及其扩展；引入滑模控制的非线性反馈（SMC-CFG）能缓解线性控制导致的失稳与过冲，在理论上保证收敛、在实践上提升语义对齐与尺度鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 本文提出统一框架CFG-Ctrl，将无分类器引导（CFG）重新解释为对连续时间一阶生成流施加的控制：以条件与无条件预测差作为误差信号来调节速度场。从该视角，标准CFG等价于固定增益的比例控制，后续多种变体可视作其扩展控制律设计。但现有方法主要依赖线性控制，导致在大引导尺度下容易不稳定、产生过冲并降低语义保真。为此，作者提出滑模控制版CFG（SMC-CFG），通过在语义预测误差上构建指数滑模面并加入切换控制项实现非线性反馈校正，并用李雅普诺夫分析给出有限时间收敛的理论保证。实验在Stable Diffusion 3.5、Flux与Qwen-Image等文本到图像模型上验证SMC-CFG在语义对齐与对不同引导尺度的鲁棒性方面优于标准CFG。
AI.summary: 该工作把扩散模型中的CFG提升为“控制生成流”的统一视角：将条件/无条件差异当作控制误差，标准CFG对应固定增益P控制。针对线性控制在高引导尺度下易失稳与过冲的问题，提出基于滑模控制的SMC-CFG：用指数滑模面与切换项提供非线性反馈，并给出李雅普诺夫稳定性与有限时间收敛分析。实验覆盖多个主流文生图模型，显示在更广的引导尺度范围内获得更好的语义对齐与更强鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 无分类器引导, CFG, 扩散模型, 流式扩散, 连续时间生成流, 控制理论, 比例控制, 滑模控制, 李雅普诺夫稳定性, 文本到图像, 语义对齐, guidance scale, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 贡献点：1) 控制论视角统一解释CFG与变体；2) 引入滑模控制实现非线性反馈并给出稳定性/有限时间收敛理论；3) 在多模型上验证大尺度更稳、更对齐。局限：未在摘要中给出具体指标、消融设置、计算开销与对视觉质量/多样性的影响细节。

title: Solving adversarial examples requires solving exponential misalignment
summary: Adversarial attacks - input perturbations imperceptible to humans that fool neural networks - remain both a persistent failure mode in machine learning, and a phenomenon with mysterious origins. To shed light, we define and analyze a network's perceptual manifold (PM) for a class concept as the space of all inputs confidently assigned to that class by the network. We find, strikingly, that the dimensionalities of neural network PMs are orders of magnitude higher than those of natural human concepts. Since volume typically grows exponentially with dimension, this suggests exponential misalignment between machines and humans, with exponentially many inputs confidently assigned to concepts by machines but not humans. Furthermore, this provides a natural geometric hypothesis for the origin of adversarial examples: because a network's PM fills such a large region of input space, any input will be very close to any class concept's PM. Our hypothesis thus suggests that adversarial robustness cannot be attained without dimensional alignment of machine and human PMs, and therefore makes strong predictions: both robust accuracy and distance to any PM should be negatively correlated with the PM dimension. We confirmed these predictions across 18 different networks of varying robust accuracy. Crucially, we find even the most robust networks are still exponentially misaligned, and only the few PMs whose dimensionality approaches that of human concepts exhibit alignment to human perception. Our results connect the fields of alignment and adversarial examples, and suggest the curse of high dimensionality of machine PMs is a major impediment to adversarial robustness.

AI.title_translation: 解决对抗样本需要解决指数级失配
AI.tldr: 论文提出“感知流形（PM）”框架，发现神经网络的PM维度远高于人类概念，导致机器与人类在概念空间上存在“指数级失配”，从几何上解释对抗样本的普遍性，并在18个网络上验证：PM维度越高，鲁棒准确率越低、任意输入到PM的距离越小；即使最鲁棒的网络仍显著失配。
AI.motivation: 对抗攻击长期存在且成因不清；作者希望用几何视角解释对抗样本为何普遍出现，并探究获得对抗鲁棒性需要满足的条件（机器概念与人类概念对齐问题）。
AI.method: 定义并分析网络对某一类别概念的“感知流形（PM）”：所有被网络高置信度判为该类的输入集合；比较网络PM的维度与“自然人类概念”的维度；基于“维度越高体积增长越快”的性质提出“指数级失配”与对抗样本来源的几何假设；提出可检验预测：鲁棒准确率与到任意PM的距离都应与PM维度负相关；在18个不同网络（鲁棒性不同）上进行实证验证这些相关关系。
AI.result: 发现神经网络PM的维度比人类概念的维度高出多个数量级，暗示机器会对指数级多的、在人类看来不属于该概念的输入仍给出高置信分类；验证了预测：鲁棒准确率与PM维度负相关，任意输入到任意类别PM的距离也与PM维度负相关；即便最鲁棒的网络仍然表现出“指数级失配”，只有少数PM维度接近人类概念的情况才表现出与人类感知更一致的对齐。
AI.conclusion: 对抗样本的根源可由高维PM导致的指数级几何失配解释；要获得对抗鲁棒性，不能仅靠现有训练技巧，而需要在维度上让机器与人类的概念PM对齐；高维机器PM的“维度灾难”是阻碍鲁棒性的关键因素，并将“对齐”与“对抗样本”两领域联系起来。
AI.translation: 提出：对抗攻击是人类难以察觉的扰动却能欺骗神经网络。作者定义并研究网络的“感知流形（PM）”：网络对某类高置信判定的所有输入集合。结果显示神经网络PM维度远高于人类概念维度，导致由于高维体积指数增长而产生机器-人类“指数级失配”，即机器会把指数级多的输入视为某概念而人类不会。由此给出对抗样本的几何解释：因为PM占据输入空间的大区域，任意输入都离任一类别PM很近，故容易找到对抗扰动。由假设推导预测：鲁棒准确率与到PM的距离都应随PM维度增大而下降。作者在18个不同网络上验证了这些预测；即便最鲁棒的网络仍指数级失配，只有少数PM维度接近人类概念时才更符合人类感知。结论认为高维PM的维度灾难是对抗鲁棒性的主要障碍。
AI.summary: 本文从几何角度将对抗样本问题重述为“概念空间对齐”问题：网络对某类的高置信输入集合（PM）在维度上远超人类概念，带来指数级的概念覆盖与失配，使得任意样本都更容易靠近某类PM，从而产生对抗样本。作者进一步提出并在18个模型上验证经验规律：PM维度越大，鲁棒准确率越差、到PM的距离越小。整体主张是：真正的对抗鲁棒性需要降低或约束机器PM维度，使其与人类概念维度对齐。
AI.keywords: 对抗样本; 对抗鲁棒性; 感知流形(PM); 维度; 指数级失配; 人机对齐; 高维几何; 置信分类; 维度灾难; 概念表示
AI.comments: 抽象中未说明：PM维度的具体定义/估计方法、所用数据集与攻击类型、18个网络的结构与训练细节、如何量化“人类概念维度”、相关性度量与统计显著性、以及是否给出可操作的降维/对齐训练算法；更多像是提出理论框架与经验相关性验证。

title: BD-Merging: Bias-Aware Dynamic Model Merging with Evidence-Guided Contrastive Learning
summary: Model Merging (MM) has emerged as a scalable paradigm for multi-task learning (MTL), enabling multiple task-specific models to be integrated without revisiting the original training data. Despite recent progress, the reliability of MM under test-time distribution shift remains insufficiently understood. Most existing MM methods typically assume that test data are clean and distributionally aligned with both the training and auxiliary sources. However, this assumption rarely holds in practice, often resulting in biased predictions with degraded generalization. To address this issue, we present BD-Merging, a bias-aware unsupervised model merging framework that explicitly models uncertainty to achieve adaptive reliability under distribution shift. First, BD-Merging introduces a joint evidential head that learns uncertainty over a unified label space, capturing cross-task semantic dependencies in MM. Second, building upon this evidential foundation, we propose an Adjacency Discrepancy Score (ADS) that quantifies evidential alignment among neighboring samples. Third, guided by ADS, a discrepancy-aware contrastive learning mechanism refines the merged representation by aligning consistent samples and separating conflicting ones. Combined with general unsupervised learning, this process trains a debiased router that adaptively allocates task-specific or layer-specific weights on a per-sample basis, effectively mitigating the adverse effects of distribution shift. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks demonstrate that BD-Merging achieves superior effectiveness and robustness compared to state-of-the-art MM baselines.

AI.title_translation: BD-Merging：基于证据引导对比学习的偏差感知动态模型合并
AI.tldr: 提出BD-Merging，一种在测试时分布偏移下更可靠的无监督模型合并方法：用联合证据头建模不确定性，提出ADS度量邻域证据对齐，并用差异感知对比学习训练去偏路由器，实现按样本自适应分配合并权重，提升鲁棒性与效果。
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法通常假设测试数据干净且与训练/辅助数据分布一致，但实际常存在分布偏移，导致合并模型产生偏置预测与泛化下降；需要在无监督条件下提升分布偏移下的合并可靠性与鲁棒性。
AI.method: BD-Merging无监督偏差感知动态合并框架：1）引入联合证据头（joint evidential head）在统一标签空间学习不确定性，捕获跨任务语义依赖；2）提出邻接差异分数ADS，量化相邻样本间的证据对齐程度；3）以ADS引导差异感知对比学习，对一致样本进行对齐、对冲突样本进行分离以精炼合并表征；4）结合通用无监督学习训练“去偏路由器”，在每个样本上自适应分配任务特定或层特定权重以完成动态合并。
AI.result: 在多样化任务上的大量实验表明，BD-Merging相较于当前最先进的模型合并基线具有更好的有效性与鲁棒性，尤其在分布偏移场景下表现更优（具体数据未在摘要中给出）。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式不确定性建模、邻域证据对齐度量（ADS）以及证据引导的差异感知对比学习，BD-Merging能够训练出按样本自适应加权的去偏路由器，从而减轻分布偏移带来的偏置预测并提升模型合并的稳健性。
AI.translation: 论文摘要翻译：模型合并（MM）已成为多任务学习（MTL）的一种可扩展范式，使得多个任务专用模型可以在不重新访问原始训练数据的情况下进行整合。尽管近期取得进展，但在测试时分布偏移下MM的可靠性仍缺乏充分理解。现有多数MM方法通常假设测试数据是干净的，并且在分布上与训练及辅助来源对齐。然而这一假设在实践中很少成立，往往导致带偏的预测并降低泛化能力。为此，我们提出BD-Merging，一种偏差感知的无监督模型合并框架，通过显式建模不确定性来在分布偏移下实现自适应可靠性。首先，BD-Merging引入联合证据头，在统一标签空间上学习不确定性，从而捕获MM中的跨任务语义依赖。其次，在该证据基础上，我们提出邻接差异分数（ADS），用于量化相邻样本之间的证据对齐程度。第三，在ADS的引导下，差异感知对比学习机制通过对齐一致样本并分离冲突样本来精炼合并后的表征。结合通用无监督学习，这一过程训练出一个去偏路由器，可在每个样本层面自适应分配任务特定或层特定权重，从而有效缓解分布偏移的不利影响。跨多种任务的大量实验表明，BD-Merging相较于最先进的MM基线方法具有更优的有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 该工作聚焦“无需访问原始数据”的多任务模型合并在测试时分布偏移下容易产生偏置与退化的问题，提出BD-Merging：用联合证据头在统一标签空间刻画不确定性与跨任务语义关系，利用ADS度量邻域样本的证据一致性，并据此进行差异感知对比学习以增强一致、拉开冲突，最终训练按样本动态分配任务/层权重的去偏路由器，实现更稳健的合并与更好的泛化。
AI.keywords: 模型合并; 多任务学习; 分布偏移; 无监督学习; 不确定性建模; 证据学习; 对比学习; 动态路由; 鲁棒性; 去偏
AI.comments: 优点：针对MM在分布偏移下的可靠性缺口提出系统方案，将证据不确定性、邻域一致性度量与对比学习结合，并通过按样本动态加权缓解偏置。局限：摘要未说明ADS的具体形式、对比学习与无监督目标的实现细节、计算开销与适用前提；实验的具体数据与分布偏移设置也未在摘要中给出。

title: Security-Constrained Substation Reconfiguration Considering Busbar and Coupler Contingencies
summary: Substation reconfiguration via busbar splitting can mitigate transmission grid congestion and reduce operational costs. However, existing approaches neglect the security of substation topology, particularly for substations without busbar splitting (i.e., closed couplers), which can lead to severe consequences. Additionally, the computational complexity of optimizing substation topology remains a challenge. This paper introduces a MILP formulation for security-constrained substation reconfiguration (SC-SR), considering N-1 line, coupler and busbar contingencies to ensure secure substation topology. To efficiently solve this problem, we propose a heuristic approach with multiple master problems (HMMP). A central master problem optimizes dispatch, while independent substation master problems determine individual substation topologies in parallel. Linear AC power flow equations ensure PF accuracy, while feasibility and optimality sub-problems evaluate contingency cases. The proposed HMMP significantly reduces computational complexity and enables scalability to large-scale power systems. Case studies on the IEEE 14-bus, 118-bus, and PEGASE 1354-bus system show the effectiveness of the approach in mitigating the impact of coupler and busbar tripping, balancing system security and cost, and computational efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 考虑母线与联络开关故障的安全约束变电站重构
AI.tldr: 提出一个考虑线路、联络开关与母线N-1故障的安全约束变电站重构MILP模型，并用多主问题启发式方法并行求解，在多种测试系统中实现安全性与成本、计算效率的平衡。
AI.motivation: 母线分裂的变电站重构可缓解拥塞、降低运行成本，但现有方法忽略变电站拓扑安全性，尤其对无母线分裂（联络开关闭合）的变电站可能带来严重后果；同时，变电站拓扑优化的计算复杂度高、可扩展性不足。
AI.method: 构建安全约束变电站重构（SC-SR）的MILP：同时考虑N-1线路、联络开关（coupler）与母线（busbar）故障；提出多主问题启发式（HMMP）：中央主问题优化系统调度，多个独立变电站主问题并行决定各自拓扑；采用线性AC潮流方程保证潮流精度；通过可行性与最优性子问题评估各类故障情景。
AI.result: 在IEEE 14节点、118节点与PEGASE 1354节点算例中，方法能有效减轻联络开关与母线跳闸的影响，在系统安全与运行成本之间取得平衡，并显著降低计算复杂度、具备大规模系统可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 所提SC-SR MILP结合HMMP并行分解框架可在考虑母线与联络开关故障的情况下实现安全的变电站重构，同时提升求解效率与可扩展性，适用于大规模电力系统运行优化。
AI.translation: 通过母线分裂实现的变电站重构可以缓解输电网拥塞并降低运行成本。然而，现有方法忽视了变电站拓扑的安全性，尤其是对不进行母线分裂（即联络开关闭合）的变电站，这可能导致严重后果。此外，变电站拓扑优化的计算复杂度仍是挑战。本文提出一种用于安全约束变电站重构（SC-SR）的MILP建模方法，考虑线路、联络开关和母线的N-1故障，以确保变电站拓扑安全。为高效求解该问题，提出多主问题启发式方法（HMMP）。其中，中央主问题优化系统调度，而独立的变电站主问题并行确定各变电站的拓扑结构。采用线性AC潮流方程以确保潮流计算精度，并通过可行性与最优性子问题评估各类故障情景。所提HMMP显著降低了计算复杂度，并支持在大规模电力系统中的可扩展应用。基于IEEE 14节点、118节点及PEGASE 1354节点系统的算例验证了该方法在减轻联络开关与母线跳闸影响、兼顾系统安全与成本以及计算效率方面的有效性。
AI.summary: 论文面向“母线分裂/变电站重构”在实际运行中可能引入的站内拓扑安全风险，提出同时覆盖线路、母线与联络开关N-1故障的安全约束优化模型，并用中央调度+站内并行拓扑的多主问题启发式框架降低复杂度；在中小到超大规模算例上验证其能在安全性、成本与计算时间之间实现更优折中。
AI.keywords: 变电站重构; 母线分裂; 安全约束; N-1故障; 母线故障; 联络开关故障; MILP; 启发式分解; 并行计算; 线性AC潮流; 拥塞管理; 大规模电力系统
AI.comments: 摘要未提及：具体目标函数形式与成本构成（如启停、网损、弃电等）、故障集规模与筛选策略、与哪些基线方法对比及量化提升幅度、算法收敛/最优性保证与最坏复杂度、对不确定性（负荷/可再生）或动态约束的处理。

title: RACAS: Controlling Diverse Robots With a Single Agentic System
comments: 7 pages in main text + 1 page of appendices + 1 page of references, 5 figures in main text + 1 figure in appendices, 2 tables in main text; source code available at https://github.com/janprz11/robot-agnostic-control
summary: Many robotic platforms expose an API through which external software can command their actuators and read their sensors. However, transitioning from these low-level interfaces to high-level autonomous behaviour requires a complicated pipeline, whose components demand distinct areas of expertise. Existing approaches to bridging this gap either require retraining for every new embodiment or have only been validated across structurally similar platforms. We introduce RACAS (Robot-Agnostic Control via Agentic Systems), a cooperative agentic architecture in which three LLM/VLM-based modules (Monitors, a Controller, and a Memory Curator) communicate exclusively through natural language to provide closed-loop robot control. RACAS requires only a natural language description of the robot, a definition of available actions, and a task specification; no source code, model weights, or reward functions need to be modified to move between platforms. We evaluate RACAS on several tasks using a wheeled ground robot, a recently published novel multi-jointed robotic limb, and an underwater vehicle. RACAS consistently solved all assigned tasks across these radically different platforms, demonstrating the potential of agentic AI to substantially reduce the barrier to prototyping robotic solutions.
comment: 7 pages in main text + 1 page of appendices + 1 page of references, 5 figures in main text + 1 figure in appendices, 2 tables in main text; source code available at https://github.com/janprz11/robot-agnostic-control

AI.title_translation: RACAS：用单一代理式系统控制多样化机器人
AI.tldr: 提出RACAS，一种由三类基于LLM/VLM的模块组成、仅用自然语言通信的闭环控制架构，只需机器人自然语言描述、动作定义与任务规格即可跨平台控制，并在轮式地面机器人、多关节新型肢体与水下机器人上稳定完成多任务。
AI.motivation: 机器人通常只提供低层API（控执行器、读传感器），要实现高层自主行为需要复杂流水线且要求多领域专长；现有跨越方法要么每换平台需重训，要么仅在结构相近平台验证，难以泛化到差异巨大的机器人。
AI.method: RACAS（Robot-Agnostic Control via Agentic Systems）：一种协作式代理架构，由三种LLM/VLM模块组成（Monitors、Controller、Memory Curator），模块间仅通过自然语言交互来实现闭环控制；跨平台迁移时只需提供机器人的自然语言描述、可用动作集合定义与任务规格，不需要改源代码、模型权重或奖励函数。
AI.result: 在多个任务上评估：轮式地面机器人、近期发表的多关节新型机器人肢体、以及水下航行器；RACAS在这些结构差异显著的平台上均能一致地解决所有分配任务。
AI.conclusion: 代理式AI（以RACAS为例）有潜力显著降低机器人方案原型开发门槛，实现无需重训/修改权重的跨机器人平台高层控制。
AI.translation: 许多机器人平台提供API，使外部软件能够命令执行器并读取传感器。然而，从这些低层接口过渡到高层自主行为需要复杂的流水线，其组件要求不同领域的专业知识。现有弥合这一差距的方法要么每遇到新“机体形态”就需要重新训练，要么只在结构相似的平台上得到验证。我们提出RACAS（通过代理式系统实现与机器人无关的控制），一种协作式代理架构，其中三个基于LLM/VLM的模块（监控器、控制器和记忆整理器）仅通过自然语言进行通信，以提供闭环机器人控制。RACAS只需要机器人的自然语言描述、可用动作的定义以及任务规格；在不同平台之间迁移时无需修改源代码、模型权重或奖励函数。我们在多项任务上评估了RACAS，涵盖轮式地面机器人、近期发表的一种新型多关节机器人肢体以及一台水下航行器。RACAS在这些差异巨大的平台上都能稳定完成所有任务，展示了代理式AI在显著降低机器人方案原型开发门槛方面的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文针对“低层API到高层自主控制”需要复杂工程流水线且难以跨平台泛化的问题，提出RACAS：由监控器、控制器与记忆整理器三类LLM/VLM模块组成、仅以自然语言互通的协作代理架构，实现闭环控制。其核心卖点是平台迁移仅依赖机器人自然语言描述、动作定义与任务说明，无需改代码/权重/奖励。实验在轮式地面、多关节肢体与水下机器人上进行，结果显示能在不同形态平台上稳定完成任务，表明该范式可降低机器人原型开发门槛。
AI.keywords: RACAS; 机器人无关控制; 代理式系统; LLM; VLM; 自然语言接口; 闭环控制; 跨平台泛化; 多机器人
AI.comments: 抽象未说明：具体任务类型与数量、评价指标与对比基线、失败案例/限制、系统延迟与实时性细节、各模块职责分工的实现细节与训练/提示策略、所用LLM/VLM模型与算力配置。

title: The Coordination Gap: Alternation Metrics for Temporal Dynamics in Multi-Agent Battle of the Exes
comments: 38 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables, 1 supplementary pdf. Submitted to Mathematical Social Sciences
summary:
Multi-agent coordination dilemmas expose a fundamental tension between individual optimization and collective welfare, yet characterizing such coordination requires metrics sensitive to temporal structure and collective dynamics. As a diagnostic testbed, we study a BoE-derived multi-agent variant of the Battle of the Exes, formalizing it as a Markov game in which turn-taking emerges as a periodic coordination regime. Conventional outcome-based metrics (e.g., efficiency and min/max fairness) are temporally blind (they cannot distinguish structured alternation from monopolistic or random access patterns) and fairness ratios lose discriminative power as n grows, obscuring inequities.
  To address this limitation, we introduce Perfect Alternation (PA) as a reference coordination regime and propose six novel Alternation (ALT) metrics designed as temporally sensitive observables of coordination quality. Using Q-learning agents as a minimal adaptive diagnostic baseline, and comparing against random-policy null processes, we uncover a clear measurement failure: despite exhibiting deceptively high traditional metrics (e.g., reward fairness often exceeding 0.9), learned policies perform up to 81% below random baselines under ALT-variant evaluation, a deficit already present in the two-agent case and intensifying as n grows.
  These results demonstrate, in this setting, that high aggregate payoffs can coexist with poor temporal coordination, and that conventional metrics may severely mischaracterize emergent dynamics. Our findings underscore the necessity of temporally aware observables for analyzing coordination in multi-agent games and highlight random-policy baselines as essential null processes for interpreting coordination outcomes relative to chance-level behavior.

AI.title_translation: 协调鸿沟：用于多智能体“前任之战”时间动态的交替度量
AI.tldr: 提出以“完美交替”为参照的6种时间敏感交替(ALT)指标，揭示传统效率/公平指标会误判多智能体协调：Q学习在传统指标很高时，按ALT评估可比随机策略差最多81%，且随智能体数增加更严重。
AI.motivation: 传统基于结果的指标（效率、公平/最小最大公平等）对时间结构“失明”，无法区分有结构的轮换、垄断式访问或随机访问；且公平比率在智能体数量n增大时区分力下降，掩盖不公平与协调缺陷，需要能刻画时间动态与集体行为的度量。
AI.method: 将源自BoE的多智能体“前任之战”形式化为马尔可夫博弈，把“轮流行动/轮换”视为周期性协调机制；提出“完美交替(PA)”作为参照协调状态，并构造6个新的交替(ALT)时间敏感指标；用Q-learning智能体作为最小自适应诊断基线，并与随机策略的零假设过程（null process）进行对比评估。
AI.result: 发现显著的“测量失效”：尽管传统指标看起来很高（如奖励公平度常>0.9），但在ALT类评估下，学习到的策略相对随机基线最多低81%；该缺陷在双智能体时已出现，并随智能体数量n增加而加剧。
AI.conclusion: 高聚合收益可以与糟糕的时间协调并存；传统指标可能严重误刻画涌现的协调动态；分析多智能体协调需要时间感知的观测量/指标，并应将随机策略基线作为解释协调结果的重要零假设参照。
AI.translation:
多智能体协调困境揭示了个体优化与集体福利之间的根本张力，但要刻画这类协调，需要对时间结构和集体动态敏感的度量。作为诊断性测试平台，我们研究了一个源自BoE的多智能体“前任之战”变体，将其形式化为一个马尔可夫博弈，其中轮流行动作为一种周期性的协调机制涌现出来。传统的基于结果的指标（如效率以及最小/最大公平）对时间维度不敏感（无法区分有结构的交替、垄断式访问或随机访问模式），并且随着n增大，公平比率的辨别力下降，从而掩盖不平等。
为解决这一限制，我们引入“完美交替”(PA)作为参考协调机制，并提出六个新的交替(ALT)度量，作为对协调质量时间敏感的可观测量。以Q学习智能体作为最小自适应诊断基线，并与随机策略的零假设过程比较，我们发现了明确的测量失败：尽管传统指标表现出具有迷惑性的高值（例如奖励公平度常超过0.9），但在ALT变体评估下，学习到的策略相对随机基线最多低81%；这种缺陷在双智能体情形已存在，并随n增大而加剧。
这些结果表明，在该设置中，高总体收益可以与较差的时间协调并存，且传统指标可能严重误判涌现动态。我们的发现强调了在多智能体博弈中分析协调所需的时间感知观测量的重要性，并强调随机策略基线作为解释协调结果的关键零假设参照。
AI.summary: 论文在多智能体“前任之战”马尔可夫博弈中，将“周期性轮换/交替”视为核心协调现象，指出效率与公平等传统指标无法识别时间结构，尤其在多智能体场景下会丧失区分力。作者以“完美交替”作为理想参照，提出6个ALT时间敏感指标，并用Q学习与随机策略基线对照，发现学习策略在传统指标很高时仍可能在时间协调上显著失败，ALT评估下可比随机差最多81%，且人数越多越糟。结论强调：评估多智能体协调必须引入时间敏感度量，并使用随机策略作为必要的零假设基线。
AI.keywords: 多智能体协调; 马尔可夫博弈; 时间动态; 交替/轮换; 完美交替; ALT指标; 公平度量; Q-learning; 随机策略基线; 诊断性测试平台
AI.comments: 提出的核心贡献是以PA为参照的ALT时间敏感指标体系，用于揭示传统“结果指标”在时间协调问题上的系统性误判；实验设置强调与随机策略零假设的对比，指出“高公平/高效率≠好协调”。ALT指标的具体定义与6项分别是什么未在摘要中展开。

title: Scaling Multilingual Semantic Search in Uber Eats Delivery
comments: 15 pages, 11 tables, 1 figure. Planned for submission to SIGIR or KDD 2026
summary: We present a production-oriented semantic retrieval system for Uber Eats that unifies retrieval across stores, dishes, and grocery/retail items. Our approach fine-tunes a Qwen2 two-tower base model using hundreds of millions of query-document interactions that were aggregated and anonymized pretraining. We train the model with a combination of InfoNCE on in-batch negatives and triplet-NCE loss on hard negatives, and we leverage Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) to serve multiple embedding sizes from a single model. Our system achieves substantial recall gains over a strong baseline across six markets and three verticals. This paper presents the end to end work including data curation, model architecture, large-scale training, and evaluation. We also share key insights and practical lessons for building a unified, multilingual, and multi-vertical retrieval system for consumer search.

title: ResearchEnvBench: Benchmarking Agents on Environment Synthesis for Research Code Execution
summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly expected to support scientific research, and recent benchmarks report progress in code repair and autonomous experimentation. However, these evaluations typically assume a pre-configured execution environment, which requires resolving complex software dependencies, aligning hardware and framework versions, and configuring distributed execution, yet this capability remains largely unbenchmarked. We introduce ResearchEnvBench, a benchmark for environment synthesis in research code execution. Given a research repository, documentation, and a target execution setting, agents must construct an environment that successfully executes at runtime. Evaluations on diverse research repositories reveal a substantial gap in current SOTA agents, with failures dominated by incomplete dependency resolution and brittle version coupling. ResearchEnvBench provides a realistic testbed for advancing autonomous agents toward reproducible scientific research.

title: Stochastic Attention via Langevin Dynamics on the Modern Hopfield Energy
comments: Main body (including references excluding the appendix): 11 pages, 2 figures and 1 table. Total paper: 26 pages, 13 figures and 7 pages
summary: Attention heads retrieve: given a query, they return a softmax-weighted average of stored values. We show that this computation is one step of gradient descent on a classical energy function, and that Langevin sampling from the corresponding distribution yields stochastic attention: a training-free sampler controlled by a single temperature. Lowering the temperature gives exact retrieval; raising it gives open-ended generation. Because the energy gradient equals the attention map, no score network, training loop, or learned model is required. We derive a closed-form entropy inflection condition that identifies the retrieval-to-generation transition temperature for any memory geometry, with a scaling law $β^*\!\sim\!\sqrt{d}$ for random patterns. We validate on five domains (64 to 4,096 dimensions). On MNIST digit images, stochastic attention is $2.6{\times}$ more novel and $2.0{\times}$ more diverse than the best learned baseline (a VAE trained on the same patterns), while matching a Metropolis-corrected gold standard. On protein sequences from the Pfam RRM family, the generation regime achieves $6.9{\times}$ lower amino acid composition divergence than the VAE (KL $= 0.060$ vs.\ $0.416$) at matched novelty, demonstrating that the training-free score function preserves family-level fidelity that learned models lose. A denoising diffusion baseline (DDPM) fails across all memory sizes tested ($K = 100$ to $3{,}500$), producing samples indistinguishable from isotropic noise. The approach requires no architectural changes to the underlying attention mechanism.

AI.title_translation: 通过现代霍普菲尔德能量上的朗之万动力学实现随机注意力
AI.tldr: 将注意力检索解释为对霍普菲尔德能量的一步梯度下降，并用朗之万采样在无需训练、仅由温度控制的情况下实现从精确检索到开放式生成的随机注意力；提出检索-生成转变温度的熵拐点条件并在多域验证优于VAE与DDPM基线。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力是确定性的softmax检索，难以在同一机制中无训练地实现可控的“检索到生成”过渡；同时希望避免依赖得分网络/训练循环/额外模型，并给出不同记忆几何下转变温度的理论刻画。
AI.method: 证明注意力计算等价于经典能量函数上的一次梯度下降（能量梯度=注意力图）；在对应分布上用朗之万动力学进行采样得到“随机注意力”，用单一温度参数控制行为（低温精确检索，高温开放式生成）；推导闭式的熵拐点条件来确定检索-生成转变温度，并给出随机模式下的标度律β* ~ √d；在5个不同维度/领域上进行实验对比（含与Metropolis校正的“金标准”以及VAE、DDPM基线）。
AI.result: 理论上：给出适用于任意记忆几何的检索-生成转变温度判据，并在随机模式下得到β* ~ √d。实验上：在MNIST上，相比同样模式训练的最佳学习基线VAE，随机注意力生成样本新颖性提升2.6×、多样性提升2.0×，且与Metropolis校正金标准匹配；在Pfam RRM蛋白序列上，在新颖性匹配时生成区的氨基酸组成散度较VAE低6.9×（KL=0.060 vs 0.416），表明无训练得分函数更能保持家族层面保真度；DDPM在所有测试的记忆规模K=100到3500上失败，样本与各向同性噪声无异。
AI.conclusion: 注意力可被视为霍普菲尔德能量下降的一步，其能量梯度直接给出注意力映射；基于朗之万采样可在不训练、不引入得分网络或架构改动的情况下，通过温度实现从精确检索到开放式生成的可控随机注意力，并在图像与蛋白序列等多域上优于学习型基线。
AI.translation: 注意力头执行检索：给定一个查询，它们返回对存储值的softmax加权平均。我们表明该计算是对一个经典能量函数进行一步梯度下降；并且从相应分布进行朗之万采样会产生随机注意力：一种无需训练、由单一温度控制的采样器。降低温度会得到精确检索；升高温度会得到开放式生成。由于能量梯度等于注意力映射，因此不需要得分网络、训练循环或学习到的模型。我们推导了一个闭式的熵拐点条件，用于识别任意记忆几何下从检索到生成的转变温度；对随机模式得到标度律β*~√d。我们在五个领域（64到4096维）上进行了验证。在MNIST手写数字图像上，随机注意力相比最佳学习基线（在相同模式上训练的VAE）新颖性高2.6倍、多样性高2.0倍，同时与经过Metropolis校正的金标准一致。在来自Pfam的RRM蛋白序列上，在新颖性匹配时，生成区相对VAE的氨基酸组成散度低6.9倍（KL=0.060 vs 0.416），表明无需训练的得分函数能保留学习模型会丢失的家族级保真度。扩散模型基线（DDPM）在所有测试的记忆规模（K=100到3500）上均失败，生成样本与各向同性噪声不可区分。该方法不需要对底层注意力机制做任何架构改动。
AI.summary: 本文将Transformer式注意力的softmax检索重解释为现代/经典霍普菲尔德能量上的一步梯度下降，并进一步用朗之万动力学在该能量诱导的分布上采样，从而得到一种无需训练、仅靠温度参数控制的“随机注意力”。温度低时样本收敛到精确记忆检索，温度高时转为开放式生成。作者推导了基于熵拐点的检索-生成转变温度闭式条件，并给出随机记忆图样下β*与维度的√d标度律。实验覆盖5个不同维度设置：在MNIST上相对VAE显著提升新颖性与多样性且匹配Metropolis校正基准；在Pfam RRM蛋白序列上在匹配新颖性时显著降低组成偏差；而DDPM在多种记忆规模下生成失败。整体方法不需要得分网络、训练流程或注意力架构改动。
AI.keywords: 随机注意力; 朗之万动力学; 现代霍普菲尔德网络; 能量基模型; 训练无关采样; 温度控制; 检索-生成转变; 熵拐点; 标度律; 蛋白序列生成; MNIST
AI.comments: 优点：把注意力与能量函数/采样统一起来，实现无需训练的可控生成；给出可计算的转变温度理论条件，并在图像与蛋白序列上展示强基线表现。局限/待明确：摘要未说明采样步数与计算开销、稳定性与收敛诊断、对真实大规模注意力/上下文长度的适用性，以及与更多强生成模型的对比设定与超参公平性细节。

title: FreeFly-Thinking : Aligning Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Continuous UAV Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation aims to enable agents to understand natural language instructions and carry out appropriate navigation actions in real-world environments. Most work focuses on indoor settings, with little research in complex outdoor scenes. Current UAV Vision-and-Language Navigation models typically act as black boxes without explicit reasoning. We introduce FreeFly-thinking, an end-to-end VLN framework that converts the UAV agent's egocentric images and language instructions into a series of actions, inspired by environment of urban architecture proposed by OpenFly. We first construct a UAV dataset for navigation task, and then performing natural language chain of thought. We adopt a two-stage training strategy: Supervised fine-tuning and Reinforcement fine-tuning. Experiments on unseen test demonstrate a strong performance, presenting robustness and efficiency in UAV navigation issue.

AI.title_translation: FreeFly-Thinking：将链式思维推理与连续无人机导航对齐
AI.tldr: 提出FreeFly-Thinking端到端无人机视觉-语言导航框架，通过自然语言链式思维显式推理，将第一视角图像与指令映射为动作序列，并用“监督微调+强化微调”两阶段训练，在未见测试中表现出更强的鲁棒性与效率。

title: Tursio for Credit Unions: Structured Data Search with Automated Context Graphs
summary: Extracting actionable insights from structured databases in regulated industries, such as credit unions, is often hindered by complex schemas, legacy systems, and stringent data governance requirements. We present Tursio, a secure, on-premises, database search platform that enables business users to query enterprise databases using natural language. Tursio automatically infers a context graph -- a schema-level metadata structure that captures join paths, column semantics, and domain annotations -- and uses it to systematically generate accurate query plans through LLM-assisted compilation, grounding, and rewriting. Unlike existing AI/BI tools that require extensive manual context curation, Tursio automates this end-to-end and deploys entirely on-premises. We demonstrate Tursio through realistic scenarios in the credit union domain, and discuss its applicability to other regulated settings.

title: SeDa: A Unified System for Dataset Discovery and Multi-Entity Augmented Semantic Exploration
comments: 16 pages, 8 figures. System for large-scale dataset discovery and multi-entity semantic exploration
summary: The continuous expansion of open data platforms and research repositories has led to a fragmented dataset ecosystem, posing significant challenges for cross-source data discovery and interpretation. To address these challenges, we introduce SeDa--a unified framework for dataset discovery, semantic annotation, and multi-entity augmented navigation. SeDa integrates more than 7.6 million datasets from over 200 platforms, spanning governmental, academic, and industrial domains. The framework first performs semantic extraction and standardization to harmonize heterogeneous metadata representations. On this basis, a topic-tagging mechanism constructs an extensible tag graph that supports thematic retrieval and cross-domain association, while a provenance assurance module embedded within the annotation process continuously validates dataset sources and monitors link availability to ensure reliability and traceability. Furthermore, SeDa employs a multi-entity augmented navigation strategy that organizes datasets within a knowledge space of sites, institutions, and enterprises, enabling contextual and provenance-aware exploration beyond traditional search paradigms. Comparative experiments with popular dataset search platforms, such as ChatPD and Google Dataset Search, demonstrate that SeDa achieves superior coverage, timeliness, and traceability. Taken together, SeDa establishes a foundation for trustworthy, semantically enriched, and globally scalable dataset exploration.

AI.title_translation: SeDa：用于数据集发现与多实体增强语义探索的统一系统

title: A Finite-Blocklength Analysis for ORBGRAND
summary: Within the Guessing Random Additive Noise Decoding (GRAND) family, ordered reliability bits GRAND (ORBGRAND) has received considerable attention for its hardware-friendly exploitation of soft information. Existing information-theoretic results for ORBGRAND are asymptotic in blocklength and do not quantify its performance at short-to-moderate blocklengths. This paper develops a finite-blocklength analysis for ORBGRAND over general bit channel, addressing the key challenge that the rank-induced decoding metric is non-additive and coupled across symbols. We first derive an ORBGRAND-specific random-coding union (RCU)-type achievability (ORB-RCU) bound on the ensemble-average error probability. We then characterize two governing decoding metrics: the transmitted-codeword metric is treated as a U-statistic and analyzed via Hoeffding decomposition, while the competing-codeword metric is reduced to a weighted sum of independent and identically distributed Bernoulli random variables and analyzed through strong large-deviation analysis. Combining these ingredients with a Berry-Esseen argument yields a second-order achievable-rate expansion and the associated normal approximation, whose first-order term is shown to equal the ORBGRAND generalized mutual information and whose second-order term defines an ORBGRAND dispersion with a single-letter variance representation. Numerical results for BPSK-modulated additive white Gaussian noise channel validate the tightness of ORB-RCU relative to the maximum-likelihood based RCU benchmark and the accuracy of the normal approximation in the operating regime of practical interest.

AI.title_translation: ORBGRAND 的有限块长分析
AI.tldr: 提出针对 ORBGRAND 的有限块长性能分析框架：推导 ORBGRAND 专用 RCU 型可达界（ORB-RCU），并给出二阶可达率展开与正态近似；在 AWGN+BPSK 数值验证其界的紧致性与近似精度。
AI.motivation: 现有 ORBGRAND 的信息论结果主要是块长趋于无穷的渐近分析，无法量化短到中等块长下的性能；且 ORBGRAND 的秩诱导译码度量非可加、符号间耦合，给有限块长分析带来关键困难。
AI.method: 1) 推导 ORBGRAND 专用的随机编码联合界（RCU）型可达界 ORB-RCU；2) 分析两类核心译码度量：将“发射码字度量”视为 U-统计量并用 Hoeffding 分解处理；将“竞争码字度量”化为加权 i.i.d. 伯努利随机变量之和并用强大偏差（large deviation）分析；3) 结合 Berry–Esseen 论证得到二阶可达率展开与相应正态近似，并给出色散的单字母方差表示。
AI.result: 得到 ORB-RCU 误码概率可达界；导出二阶可达率展开/正态近似：一阶项等于 ORBGRAND 的广义互信息（GMI），二阶项定义 ORBGRAND 色散且具有单字母方差表达；在 BPSK 调制 AWGN 信道的数值结果表明 ORB-RCU 相对基于 ML 的 RCU 基准较紧，正态近似在实际关心工作区间内准确。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 ORBGRAND 在一般比特信道上的短到中等块长性能提供了可操作的理论刻画：给出紧的可达界与二阶近似，并将一阶性能与 GMI、二阶性能与单字母色散联系起来，且通过 AWGN+BPSK 实验验证有效性。
AI.translation: 在 Guessing Random Additive Noise Decoding（GRAND）家族中，ordered reliability bits GRAND（ORBGRAND）因其以硬件友好的方式利用软信息而受到广泛关注。现有关于 ORBGRAND 的信息论结果多为块长渐近结论，无法量化其在短到中等块长下的性能。本文针对一般比特信道建立 ORBGRAND 的有限块长分析，解决秩诱导译码度量非可加且跨符号耦合这一关键挑战。首先，我们推导了 ORBGRAND 专用的随机编码联合界（RCU）型可达界（ORB-RCU），用于刻画集合平均误码概率。随后，我们表征两个主导译码度量：将发射码字度量作为 U-统计量，并通过 Hoeffding 分解进行分析；将竞争码字度量化简为加权的独立同分布伯努利随机变量之和，并用强大偏差分析处理。将这些结果与 Berry–Esseen 论证结合，得到二阶可达率展开及其对应的正态近似，其中一阶项被证明等于 ORBGRAND 的广义互信息，二阶项定义了具有单字母方差表示的 ORBGRAND 色散。针对 BPSK 调制的加性白高斯噪声信道的数值结果验证了 ORB-RCU 相对基于最大似然的 RCU 基准的紧致性，以及正态近似在实际关注工作区间内的准确性。
AI.summary: 论文围绕 ORBGRAND 在有限块长下的误码性能与可达率进行信息论刻画。核心贡献是构建 ORBGRAND 专用的 ORB-RCU 可达界，并通过 U-统计量/Hoeffding 分解与强大偏差技术分别处理发射码字与竞争码字两类非加性、耦合的译码度量，进而在 Berry–Esseen 工具下得到二阶可达率与正态近似：一阶项对应 ORBGRAND 的 GMI，二阶项给出单字母形式的色散。数值实验（AWGN+BPSK）表明所推界紧且近似在实用区间有效。
AI.keywords: ORBGRAND; GRAND; 有限块长; RCU 可达界; 随机编码联合界; U-统计量; Hoeffding 分解; 强大偏差; Berry–Esseen; 二阶可达率; 正态近似; 广义互信息(GMI); 色散; AWGN; BPSK
AI.comments: 优点：针对 ORBGRAND 非可加译码度量给出专门的有限块长界与二阶展开，并提供单字母色散表达与数值验证。局限/未提及：未在摘要中说明对具体码族/实现复杂度的影响、与不同信道/调制的更广泛对比，以及界计算的实际代价。

title: A Systematic Comparison of Training Objectives for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Image Classification
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is critical in safety-sensitive applications. While this challenge has been addressed from various perspectives, the influence of training objectives on OOD behavior remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we present a systematic comparison of four widely used training objectives: Cross-Entropy Loss, Prototype Loss, Triplet Loss, and Average Precision (AP) Loss, spanning probabilistic, prototype-based, metric-learning, and ranking-based supervision, for OOD detection in image classification under standardized OpenOOD protocols. Across CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet-200, we find that Cross-Entropy Loss, Prototype Loss, and AP Loss achieve comparable in-distribution accuracy, while Cross-Entropy Loss provides the most consistent near- and far-OOD performance overall; the other objectives can be competitive in specific settings.

AI.title_translation: 用于图像分类中分布外检测训练目标的系统性比较
AI.tldr: 在统一的OpenOOD评测协议下，系统比较四种训练目标对图像分类OOD检测的影响；在CIFAR-10/100与ImageNet-200上，交叉熵在近/远OOD上整体最稳定，其他目标在特定设置下可具竞争力。
AI.motivation: OOD检测对安全敏感应用至关重要，但训练目标对OOD行为的影响相对研究不足，因此需要在标准化协议下进行系统比较。
AI.method: 在标准化OpenOOD协议下，对四种常用训练目标进行系统比较：交叉熵损失（概率监督）、原型损失（基于原型）、三元组损失（度量学习）、平均精度AP损失（排序监督）；任务为图像分类OOD检测，数据集覆盖CIFAR-10/100与ImageNet-200。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100与ImageNet-200上，交叉熵、原型损失与AP损失取得相近的分布内分类准确率；总体而言交叉熵在近OOD与远OOD检测性能上最一致、最稳定；其他训练目标在特定设置下可达到有竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 不同训练目标会影响OOD检测行为；在所评测的标准协议与数据集上，交叉熵损失提供最一致的整体OOD检测表现，同时原型损失、三元组损失与AP损失在某些场景中也可能是有效替代方案。
AI.translation: 分布外（OOD）检测在安全敏感应用中至关重要。尽管该挑战已从多种角度被研究，但训练目标对OOD行为的影响仍相对缺乏系统探讨。本文在标准化的OpenOOD协议下，系统比较了四种广泛使用的训练目标：交叉熵损失、原型损失、三元组损失和平均精度（AP）损失，分别代表概率式、原型式、度量学习式和排序式监督，用于图像分类中的OOD检测。在CIFAR-10/100与ImageNet-200上，我们发现交叉熵、原型损失与AP损失具有相近的分布内准确率；同时，交叉熵在近OOD与远OOD任务上的整体表现最为一致，而其他目标在特定设置下也可能具备竞争力。
AI.summary: 本文关注“训练目标如何影响图像分类的OOD检测”。作者在OpenOOD标准协议下，对交叉熵、原型、三元组与AP四类典型损失进行统一对比，并在CIFAR-10/100及ImageNet-200上实验。结果显示：分布内准确率方面交叉熵/原型/AP相当；OOD方面交叉熵在近/远OOD上整体最稳定，其他损失在某些设置中可达到相近或竞争性效果。
AI.keywords: 分布外检测; OOD检测; 图像分类; 训练目标; 交叉熵损失; 原型损失; 三元组损失; 平均精度损失; 度量学习; 排序学习; OpenOOD; CIFAR-10; CIFAR-100; ImageNet-200
AI.comments: 摘要未提及：具体OOD评价指标（如AUROC/FPR95）、网络结构与训练细节、各损失的实现形式与超参数、统计显著性分析、以及哪些“特定设置”下其他目标更优或接近交叉熵。

title: SGI: Structured 2D Gaussians for Efficient and Compact Large Image Representation
summary: 2D Gaussian Splatting has emerged as a novel image representation technique that can support efficient rendering on low-end devices. However, scaling to high-resolution images requires optimizing and storing millions of unstructured Gaussian primitives independently, leading to slow convergence and redundant parameters. To address this, we propose Structured Gaussian Image (SGI), a compact and efficient framework for representing high-resolution images. SGI decomposes a complex image into multi-scale local spaces defined by a set of seeds. Each seed corresponds to a spatially coherent region and, together with lightweight multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs), generates structured implicit 2D neural Gaussians. This seed-based formulation imposes structural regularity on otherwise unstructured Gaussian primitives, which facilitates entropy-based compression at the seed level to reduce the total storage. However, optimizing seed parameters directly on high-resolution images is a challenging and non-trivial task. Therefore, we designed a multi-scale fitting strategy that refines the seed representation in a coarse-to-fine manner, substantially accelerating convergence. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that SGI achieves up to 7.5x compression over prior non-quantized 2D Gaussian methods and 1.6x over quantized ones, while also delivering 1.6x and 6.5x faster optimization, respectively, without degrading, and often improving, image fidelity. Code is available at https://github.com/zx-pan/SGI.
